name: ACCEL Middle College (East Side Union / Evergreen Valley College)

grades: Currently in high school or college
deadline_text: The page does not state an application window or ongoing intake.

name: California Girls State (American Legion Auxiliary)
org: American Legion Auxiliary, Department of California
city: California (session location not stated on the site)

grades: 11th grade (the site says each delegate is an 11th grader during the 2025-26 school year)
deadline_text: 2026 session: June 22-27, 2026. 2027 dates and application deadlines are not posted on the site.

name: Aquatic Internship Program
org: City of Alameda Recreation and Parks, Aquatics
what_you_do: You help pool staff and learn how to keep swimmers safe. You get safety and rescue training and a mentor from the aquatics team.
deadline_text: The 2026 program page said applications close May 8, or sooner if the program fills. Interviews began the week of May 15. The next year is not posted.

name: City of Alameda Summer Internship
what_you_do: You work a summer internship with the City of Alameda. The program page does not list the tasks.
deadline_text: The program page says details are usually posted in March and applications are due in mid-May. It gives no year.

name: Alameda County Community Food Bank: Volunteer
what_you_do: Sign up for volunteer shifts at the food bank warehouse in Oakland. Tasks and times are listed on the volunteer calendar.
deadline_text: No deadline. Pick a shift on the volunteer calendar.

org: Alameda County Board of Supervisors, District 1
city: Pleasanton, CA (serves Dublin, Fremont, Livermore, Pleasanton and Sunol)

deadline_text: The application is open for School Year 26-27. The program page lists no deadline.

name: Alameda County Fair Seasonal Jobs
what_you_do: You work at the county fair. Jobs include tickets at the gate, exhibits, the animal barns, parking, the tram and event work.
deadline_text: The program page says 2027 information is coming soon. Hiring dates and the fair dates are not posted yet.

name: Student Intern Program
what_you_do: You join a county tech team for the summer. You help build apps and tools for the County. You may work on apps, websites, tech help, networks, security or servers.
grades: High school, college or STEM trade school students
deadline_text: Applications for Cohort 2026 are closed. The program page says it will post more information in February or March 2027.

name: Alameda County Library Teen Volunteers (Fremont, Newark, Union City)
city: Fremont, Newark and Union City, CA
what_you_do: The library's Volunteer with the Library page links to volunteer opportunities on its Better Impact portal. The page does not say which roles take teens.
deadline_text: Not stated on the page.

name: Alameda Free Library Teen Advisory Group (TAG)
what_you_do: You suggest ideas for library events and projects. You earn 1 service hour per meeting.
deadline_text: The page states no deadline or intake dates.

name: Alameda Free Library Teen Volunteers (Book Reviewers and Coding with LEGO)
what_you_do: You can write teen book reviews. Each review is 1 service hour, one a month. Or you can help younger kids with LEGO coding activities.
deadline_text: The page states no deadline or intake dates.

name: Alameda High School Career Technical Education (CTE) Pathways
org: Alameda High School, Alameda Unified School District
what_you_do: You take career classes at Alameda High. There are five paths to pick from. They are digital filmmaking, multimedia, computer science, sports medicine and biotech.
deadline_text: The program page lists no deadlines. Ask your counselor when you pick classes.

name: Teen Haunted House Volunteers
org: City of Alameda Recreation and Parks
city: Alameda, CA (Veterans Building and South Shore Mall)
what_you_do: You design and build haunted rooms, props and special effects for the Teen Haunted House. You also act as a scare actor on haunted house nights.
deadline_text: Registration for the 21st annual haunted house closed September 20, 2026. Dates for next year are not posted on the program page.

name: Alameda Youth Career and Job Fair
org: City of Alameda and Alameda Unified School District
what_you_do: This is a free fair. You meet employers, schools, nonprofits and trade groups. You can explore careers, part-time jobs, internships and training.
deadline_text: The 10th annual fair was Wednesday, April 1, 2026, 1 to 5 pm. No 2027 date is posted.

name: Alameda Youth Committee (AYC)
org: City of Alameda Recreation and Parks, Underground Teen Center
what_you_do: You work with other teens to create programs and events. You build skills in teamwork, communication and civic engagement.
deadline_text: The program page says the committee runs in Fall 2026 and links to online registration. It gives no open or close dates.

name: Anaheim Fire and Rescue Explorer Program
what_you_do: Learn basic fire and life-saving skills with Anaheim firefighters. Meetings mix fitness, class time and skills practice. After six months you can ride along on fire engines and ambulances.
deadline_text: No dates are posted. Join the interest list to hear when spots open.

name: Anaheim Public Library Teen Volunteers
what_you_do: Volunteer at an Anaheim library branch. Some branches ask for 2 hours a week. You can also work online on a teen blog, a teen podcast or book catalog translation.
deadline_text: Dates depend on the branch. East Anaheim, Haskett, Heritage Center, Ponderosa and Sunkist take applications year-round. Central Library takes them at the start of summer, fall and spring. Canyon Hills takes them in September, January and May, for summer work. Euclid takes them during the spring semester, for summer work.

name: Anaheim Summer VolunTEEN Program
org: City of Anaheim Community Services Department
what_you_do: Volunteer at summer programs in Anaheim. You can help at day camps, nature camps, libraries and a gym. You earn community service hours.
deadline_text: The 2026 applications are closed. Last cycle, applications opened Feb 2, 2026 and closed Apr 10, 2026 at 5 p.m. No late applications were accepted.

name: VolunTEENS at the Aquarium of the Pacific
what_you_do: Talk with aquarium guests about ocean life and conservation at touch pools and education carts. You get trained, then work one set day a week.
deadline_text: 2026 windows: Summer applications Mar 1 to Apr 15; Fall applications Jun 20 to Aug 5. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: TRIO Upward Bound and Upward Bound Math and Science (American River College)
what_you_do: You get free tutoring and academic advising. You get help with college applications and financial aid. You go on campus visits. You do career exploration. The program has monthly Saturday Academies. It also has a required summer part.
deadline_text: No deadline posted on the page.

name: Teen Volunteer Program
org: Arrowhead Regional Medical Center (San Bernardino County)
what_you_do: Volunteer at the county hospital on one weekly shift. You give at least 100 hours of service.
deadline_text: No application dates are posted on the page.

name: Armory Center for the Arts Studio Teen Volunteers
what_you_do: Help the teaching artists in the Armory's kids' Studio classes. You help with set up and clean up, and you help during class each session.
deadline_text: No dates or deadline listed.

name: Assisteens Auxiliary (Assistance League of Newport-Mesa)
what_you_do: Volunteer in a thrift shop. Help give school clothes to low-income families. Do service projects with your grade. You can also be a leader.
deadline_text: No sign-up dates are posted on the program page. Call for details.

name: BART Summer Internship (high school)
what_you_do: You get a paid summer internship at BART, 10 to 20 hours a week, in person.
deadline_text: 2026 program ran June 22 to July 31, 2026. Direct applications are not accepted. 2027 not posted.

name: Berkeley High CTE Pathways
what_you_do: You can follow career pathways at Berkeley High. There are six areas. They are health, public service, arts and media, IT, engineering and building trades. You can earn credit for an internship or work-based learning.
deadline_text: Choose pathway classes during course selection.

name: Berkeley Humane Volunteer (teens 12 and up)
what_you_do: After a volunteer orientation, you can help in the thrift shop. You can help at adoption events or in the vet clinic. You can help with foster care or office work.
deadline_text: No volunteer application deadline is posted, and the page does not say whether orientation sign-ups are ongoing. Internships are 18+ only and are available year-round.

name: Berkeley Pre-College Scholars (Summer Sessions)
what_you_do: Take UC Berkeley summer classes for college credit in a 6 or 8 week session.
deadline_text: 2026 application ran Feb 2 to Mar 17, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.

name: Berkeley Public Library Teen Volunteer and Youth Worker
what_you_do: You can volunteer at a Berkeley library. Use the Teen Volunteer Application. Or work as a paid Youth Worker, up to 15 hours a week. Berkeley YouthWorks hires Youth Workers.
deadline_text: Berkeley YouthWorks Winter 2027 interest form is due October 30, 2026. Positions generally run January to March 2027. Filling out the form does not guarantee placement.

name: Teen Council
org: Berkeley Repertory Theatre, School of Theatre
what_you_do: 10 to 15 Bay Area high schoolers are in this council. They plan Teen Night programs. They host original works showcases. They organize advocacy events. They interview artists.
deadline_text: A new group is chosen at the start of each school year. No 2026 to 2027 dates are posted; join the mailing list for news.

name: Berkeley YouthWorks
what_you_do: You can get a paid, part-time, temporary internship through the City of Berkeley. The Ready to Work workshop series pays a stipend.
deadline_text: Interest form for Winter 2027 is due October 30, 2026. Summer 2027 information is expected February 2027. Fall 2026 is full through November 2026.

name: Beyond Emancipation (B:E) employment coaching for foster youth
what_you_do: If you are a current or former foster youth in Alameda County, you can get coaching. The coaching covers career interests. It also covers resumes and budgeting. You can get help with job connections. You can get help with training or apprenticeships.
deadline_text: No application window or intake deadline is stated on the program pages. Call or email to ask how to start.

name: Junior Staff (Boys & Girls Clubs of Oakland)
what_you_do: Club teens who meet the requirements take paid work positions at the Club. The page says these give real work experience and professional development.
deadline_text: Not stated on the page.

name: Teen Summer Program
org: Boys & Girls Clubs of San Leandro
city: San Leandro, CA (Teen Clubhouse, 2200 San Leandro Blvd)
what_you_do: You pick hands-on classes such as digital media, cooking, sports, art, tech, wellness and college readiness. You make your own summer schedule at the teen clubhouse.
deadline_text: The program page is for summer 2027 and says details are coming this spring. No dates are posted.

name: Bowers Museum Junior Ambassadors
what_you_do: Work with museum staff to build speaking and leadership skills. You lead visitors on gallery tours. You talk about art and objects from around the world.
deadline_text: The last open house was Saturday, May 2, 2026, 10:00 to 11:00 a.m. Dates for the next program year are not posted on the page.

name: Teaching Intern and Summer Volunteer
what_you_do: Teach and tutor middle schoolers in a six-week summer program after 80 hours of training. The site says college and high school students serve as teachers.
deadline_text: Not posted.

name: American Legion California Boys State (Boys & Girls State)
what_you_do: You spend a week at Sacramento State in a summer program for students who finished junior year. You run a mock state government. It has been open to all genders since 2023.
grades: Finished 11th grade, with at least one semester of high school left
deadline_text: 2027 selection dates are not posted. The Key Dates page (year not labeled) shows delegate selection Jan 15 to Apr 1 and all registrations due Apr 1. Posts usually interview late Jan to late March.

name: California Highway Patrol Explorer Program
what_you_do: Teens in Explorer posts learn law enforcement skills. They can compete at the CHP statewide Explorer competition. It is at the CHP Academy in West Sacramento. Contact CHP to find a post.
deadline_text: No post sign-up dates are stated. The 2026 competition registration opened December 2025 and full payment was due February 23, 2026. Both have passed.

name: California Division of Apprenticeship Standards: how apprenticeship works and minimum ages
org: California Department of Industrial Relations, Division of Apprenticeship Standards
what_you_do: You can use the Apprenticeship Search to find registered apprenticeship and pre-apprenticeship programs near you. The state agency that registers them is the Division of Apprenticeship Standards.
deadline_text: Each program sets its own application window.

name: Youth Employment Opportunity Program (YEOP)
city: California (YEOP specialists at local EDD offices)
what_you_do: Peer mentors and career coaches help with resumes, interview practice and job search. They also run workshops. They can refer you to GED, diploma or job training programs. It is not a job placement program.
deadline_text: No application dates. Contact a YEOP specialist any time.

name: EDD Employment Services for Youth (America's Job Centers of California)
city: California (local America's Job Center of California offices)
what_you_do: Get youth job services. Go to your local America's Job Center of California. EDD lists mentoring, school help and skills training. It lists leadership development. Work experience can be paid or unpaid. It has internships, apprenticeships and job shadowing.
deadline_text: No application dates. Visit or contact your local center any time.

name: California State Parks Volunteers in Parks (youth)
what_you_do: You can volunteer or intern at state parks. If you are under 18, you can volunteer with written permission from a parent or guardian.
deadline_text: The page lists no application deadline.

name: California Volunteers Youth Service Corps
org: California Volunteers (Office of the Governor), run through partner cities and counties
city: California (23 partner cities, counties and tribes)
what_you_do: Paid service and job experience for young people in their own community. Members work through a city or county partner. The state page does not list job duties.
deadline_text: The state page does not say whether applications are open. Each partner city or county runs its own application.

name: California Work Experience Education (Exploratory, General, Career Technical)
what_you_do: Work Experience Education (WEE) is a school-supervised job that earns class credit. Exploratory WEE is unpaid job sampling and can start at age 12. General and Career Technical WEE are paid jobs that come with a related class.
deadline_text: Ask your counselor or the school's work experience coordinator.

name: Next-Gen Manufacturing Academy (High School Summer Academy)
what_you_do: You spend summer days on campus. You build skills in engineering, robotics and AI. You build smart robots. No experience is needed.
deadline_text: Page says applications open in January and close in April each year. Exact 2027 dates not posted.

name: California 4-H Youth Development
what_you_do: Join a 4-H club, SPIN club or camp in your county. You start with one project and can join county and state events.
deadline_text: Join any time. Animal shows at county fairs have their own deadlines.

grades: Grades 4 to 12 per the program site; the state military page says grades 6 to 12
name: California Cadet Corps (school based leadership program)
org: California Cadet Corps, California Military Department
what_you_do: This is a school class or after school program. Cadets lead their peers, plan events and serve their community. They learn citizenship, leadership and wellness. Events include drill, summer camp and leadership conferences.
deadline_text: No dates. Enrollment follows your school's schedule.

grades: Not stated on the program pages
name: California FBLA (Future Business Leaders of America)
city: California (through school chapters in six geographic sections)
what_you_do: Join a school business club. It has contests, leadership training and conferences. These include section and state conferences. There is also a national conference.
deadline_text: No join deadline on the page.

name: California FFA and Supervised Agricultural Experience (SAE)
org: California FFA and National FFA Organization
what_you_do: You learn agriculture in class. You run a hands-on Supervised Agricultural Experience. It can be a job or a project. You build leadership through events.
deadline_text: Join through your ag teacher.

name: California Partnership Academies (CPA)
what_you_do: You can join a three-year 'school within a school' for grades 10 to 12. It mixes academics with a career focus, business mentors and internships.
deadline_text: The CDE page lists no student application dates. Each school sets its own.

name: Community Teen Intern Program
what_you_do: A paid job at the museum. You lead hands-on science activities and shows for guests, like fire demos and dive shows, and help at community events.
deadline_text: Closed for 2026-27. The page says to check back in August 2027 for the 2027-28 school year.

name: Dive Team Interns
what_you_do: A paid summer internship about ocean science and SCUBA. You learn diving basics in practice sessions, try one open water dive, meet marine science workers and help museum guests.
deadline_text: Closed for Summer 2026. The page did not post application dates. Summer 2027 dates are not posted yet.

name: Flight Team Interns
what_you_do: A paid summer internship about flight. You do hands-on activities on how planes fly, meet people who work in aviation, help museum guests and take a trip on a commercial flight.
deadline_text: Closed for Summer 2026. The page did not post application dates. Summer 2027 dates are not posted yet.

name: Youth Volunteers Program
what_you_do: Earn service hours at a free science museum. You help guests in the galleries and IMAX theater, greet visitors, or help in the gift store.
deadline_text: Spring 2027 applications open Nov 1, 2026. All Fall 2026 youth spots are full. No closing date is posted.

name: Caltech Summer Research Connection (Pasadena Unified high school students)
org: Caltech Center for Teaching, Learning, and Outreach
what_you_do: Six weeks in a Caltech research lab. Students work in student-teacher teams under research mentors and give a seminar presentation at the end.
deadline_text: Spots are limited and usually fill by early spring. The page mentions summer 2026 only. No 2027 dates are posted.

name: Supporting Student Success (WIOA In-School Youth)
org: Contra Costa County Office of Education
city: Contra Costa County, CA (West County and East County)

org: Contra Costa County Office of Education
what_you_do: Get career and school guidance plus a paid work experience that runs all year. The programs are We Can Work, WorkAbility I, WIOA and the Transition Partnership Program.

what_you_do: You help at a large hospital. Tasks include scanning and entering data. You welcome new patients and answer phones. You deliver flowers and amenities. Teens do not do research or help with medical procedures.
deadline_text: 2027 sessions: Winter/Spring (Jan 25 to Apr 4) applications Nov 23, 2026; Summer (Jun 21 to Jul 25) applications Mar 29, 2027; Fall (Oct 4 to Dec 12) applications Aug 2, 2027. First come, first served; each application closes when spots fill.

name: Chabot College Early College (Dual Enrollment)

deadline_text: Rolling by term.

name: Galaxy Explorers Program
what_you_do: You spend three years in this STEM and workforce program. You work museum floor shifts explaining science. You join inquiry teams on engineering and tech projects. You can take leadership roles in later years.
grades: Typically enters the summer before 10th grade and stays through 12th grade
deadline_text: Applications open each year from February 1 to March 31. Decisions in early May, orientation early to mid June. The page does not list 2027 dates.

name: Chapman Pharmacy Summer Research Program for High School Students
what_you_do: Join a small group of 3 to 5 students. Work with a faculty advisor on a pharmacy research project. You use lab tools, write a report and present your results.
deadline_text: The 2026 program was full. The page offers a waitlist. Dates for 2027 are not posted.

name: Chapman Social Science Summer Pre-College Research Experience
what_you_do: Do real social science research with professors and Chapman student mentors. You study data from a national survey about fears. You make a poster and share your findings.
deadline_text: Registration for Summer 2027 opens in spring 2027. You can join the priority list now.

name: Chapman University Summer Engineering Academy
org: Chapman University, Fowler School of Engineering
what_you_do: Take hands-on engineering workshops on campus. Topics include AI, game development, bioprinting, 3D printing and app design. You need no experience.
deadline_text: Summer 2027 dates are not posted. Join the interest list on the program page.

name: High School Summer Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Volunteer at a children's hospital for seven weeks in summer. You walk patients to appointments, greet families and give small gifts to patients, and help with office work.
deadline_text: The 2027 dates are not posted. Last cycle, the application opened Jan 26, 2026 at 4 p.m. and closed Feb 2, 2026 at 4 p.m. The program ran June 22 to Aug 6, 2026.

name: CHP Explorer Post (East Sacramento)
what_you_do: You can join an Explorer post for teens who want a law enforcement career. You get training and mentoring from CHP officers.
deadline_text: Rolling.

what_you_do: Help at a nature center and wildlife rescue by supporting events, working on the grounds and in the office, and later in animal care. Orientations are held on weekends.

name: Civil Air Patrol Cadet Program (California Wing)

city: California (squadrons in eight regional groups, Los Angeles to San Diego)
what_you_do: Cadets join a local squadron for weekly meetings. They learn leadership, aerospace and fitness. They can take orientation flights and go to events and an encampment.
deadline_text: Join any time. Attend about three meetings, then complete the application.

name: FARMS Leadership Program
what_you_do: You are in a school-year group. The group visits farms, conservation sites, agriculture businesses and colleges. There are at least six field days. You build resume, interview and speaking skills.
deadline_text: No dates posted. Schools sign up as groups.

name: Urban Ag Internships
what_you_do: You get a year-long paid internship at a school garden. It includes weekly garden hours, a workforce class, field trips to farms and guest speakers.
deadline_text: No dates posted on the page.

name: College of Alameda Concurrent Enrollment for High School Students
what_you_do: You take real college classes while you are still in high school.
deadline_text: The program page lists no deadlines or term dates.

what_you_do: Take free college classes at College of San Mateo while in high school. Dual enrollment is through partner high schools. It includes free books and materials. Concurrent enrollment is free for up to 11 units a semester.
deadline_text: No application deadline stated on the program pages.

name: Computer History Museum Teen Volunteer Intern Program
what_you_do: Teens in grades 9 to 12 go behind the scenes with the education team. They research tech history. They meet Silicon Valley professionals. They lead tours and activities.
deadline_text: Applications are currently closed. Join the interest list to hear about the next round.

name: Youth Volunteering at the Food Bank of Contra Costa and Solano
org: Food Bank of Contra Costa and Solano
city: Concord, CA (warehouse and distribution sites across Contra Costa County)
what_you_do: Help get food to neighbors in need. Volunteers work at food warehouses in Concord and Fairfield and at community food distribution sites. You sign up for a shift on the volunteer calendar.
deadline_text: Shifts are posted on the volunteer calendar. You must sign up for a shift ahead of time because walk-ins are not allowed.

name: Youth Member, Parks, Recreation and Open Space Commission
what_you_do: Sit on the city commission that gives advice on parks, open space, recreation and youth. You share a teen view with the City Council and help shape park and recreation plans.
deadline_text: The 2026 deadline was Friday, June 12, 2026 at 5 PM. The city says it holds a formal recruitment in odd-numbered years, or when a seat opens. The next dates are not posted.

name: Contra Costa 4-H Youth Development Program
what_you_do: Join a local 4-H club and pick projects to work on during the year. Most meetings and activities are from August through May.
deadline_text: Youth enrollment opened Aug 3, 2026 for the 2026-2027 program year. The page gives no closing date.

name: Contra Costa College Dual Enrollment
what_you_do: You can take free college classes. There is no cost for tuition, books or enrollment fees. You must attend West Contra Costa USD, Leadership Public Schools, Griffin Technology Academies or Middle College High School. Classes are on campus.
deadline_text: Rolling by term.

name: Contra Costa County Library Teen Volunteers
city: Contra Costa County, CA (Richmond, Concord, Pleasant Hill and other branches)
what_you_do: Teen roles include Summer Read volunteer, Computer Docent and Homework Help.
grades: Entering 8th grade or above (Summer Read); age 16+ for other roles
deadline_text: Summer Read recruiting starts in April. Some libraries take volunteers on a limited basis.

name: Youth Services, Workforce Development Board of Contra Costa County
org: Workforce Development Board of Contra Costa County
what_you_do: Get help to finish school, find a job or start a career. Help can include a case manager, job training, work, a mentor and help with school.
deadline_text: The board offers services all year. No deadline is stated.

name: COSMOS (California State Summer School for Mathematics and Science) at UC Davis
what_you_do: You spend four weeks living on campus. It is a summer program with college-level math and science courses. You also do hands-on projects.
deadline_text: Application opens Jan 6, 2027 at 8:00 AM and closes Feb 5, 2027 (dates page says 5:00 PM). Financial aid forms postmarked by Feb 6, 2027. Decisions Mar 25, 2027.

name: COSMOS (California State Summer School for Mathematics and Science) at UC Merced
what_you_do: Live at UC Merced for four weeks in summer and study advanced science and math topics with professors and researchers. The classes are hands-on and include a lot of lab work.

name: Orange Coast College Dual Enrollment

what_you_do: Take OCC college classes while in high school, on campus or online (concurrent), or in classes held at a partner high school (CCAP). Classes earn college units and can count toward high school credit.
deadline_text: No fixed date. Apply for the term you want. Forms take at least 7 to 10 business days to process.

deadline_text: Jobs are posted on the city's job page. No dates are stated.

name: Teen Action Academy and Teen Leadership Committee
what_you_do: Teen Action Academy is for grades 9 to 12. It plans service projects and teen events. Teen Leadership Committee is for grades 7 to 8. It builds leadership and teamwork.
deadline_text: Registration for the 2026-27 Teen Leadership Committee and Teen Action Academy is open now. The page gives no closing date.

name: Cosumnes Fire Department Explorer Program
org: Cosumnes Community Services District Fire Department
what_you_do: You get classroom and hands-on fire training. You practice leadership. You earn community service hours.
deadline_text: Applications for the next school year open in Spring 2027 (no exact date or closing date posted).

name: Cottage Health Junior Volunteers
what_you_do: Volunteer at a Cottage Health hospital near Santa Barbara. You help patients, families, guests and staff. Plan on about four hours a week.
deadline_text: No application dates are posted. The page invites volunteers who can give four hours a week.

name: CPMC Information Desk Volunteer (Van Ness Campus, Sutter Health)
org: Sutter Health, California Pacific Medical Center (CPMC)
city: San Francisco, CA (CPMC Van Ness Campus, 1101 Van Ness Avenue)
what_you_do: Help visitors and patients who come into the main lobby at CPMC Van Ness Campus. Give directions, information and help. The listing says the desk is open 24 hours.
deadline_text: The listing shows Actively Recruiting. No application deadline is stated.

name: California State Summer School for the Arts (CSSSA)

deadline_text: 2027 application opens in November (timeline lists Nov 1, 2026). Application and scholarship priority deadline is Feb 28, 2027, 6 pm, with no extensions. Session: registration July 3, classes July 5, graduation July 31, 2027.

name: Cupertino Teen Commission
