deadline_text: The city page says recruitment is currently closed. No reopening date is stated.

name: Town of Danville Volunteer Program
org: Town of Danville Recreation, Arts and Community Services
what_you_do: Help at town events and long projects, such as art gallery helper or theatre usher. You can do one event or stay longer.
deadline_text: New chances are posted through the year. Each posting shows its own dates.

name: Danville Youth Council (DYC)
org: Town of Danville Recreation, Arts and Community Services
what_you_do: Join a teen group in Danville. You help create programs and special events for youth and teens. You also volunteer and donate time and resources to people in need.
deadline_text: The page does not give application dates for 2026-27. It lists the 2025-26 meetings: second Monday of the month, September to May, 4:30 to 5:30 PM.

name: Lifeguard Training, Junior Lifeguarding and Junior Swim Instructor
what_you_do: You can take Red Cross lifeguard training. You can also take a junior lifeguard class. Or try Junior Swim Instructor, where you shadow instructors. This can lead to volunteer chances and city aquatics jobs.
deadline_text: Courses are offered throughout the year. Check WebTrac for sessions.

name: Davis Junior Basketball Coach, Official and Score Keeper
org: City of Davis Parks and Community Services
what_you_do: You referee or keep score at youth basketball games on Saturdays, or coach a team of 3rd to 6th graders. Hours are 5 to 10 a week for officials and 3 to 8 for coaches.
deadline_text: The posting is open continuously. Mandatory training is the week of January 4, 2027 and a coaching clinic on January 9, 2027.

name: Davis Senior High CTE Pathways
what_you_do: You can take school classes in career pathways. The pathways are in seven industry sectors. Courses come in a sequence. The district also offers student internships through its career program.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. Enroll through your counselor during normal course selection.

name: Teen Leadership Council
org: City of Davis Parks and Community Services
what_you_do: You plan events and service projects. You learn leadership skills. You speak up on issues that matter to Davis teens.
deadline_text: The 2026-27 application period was extended to Oct 2, 2026 and is now closed. The next call is not posted.

name: De Anza College Dual Enrollment
what_you_do: Take De Anza College classes, online or on campus, while in high school. Many courses count toward CSU or UC credit.
deadline_text: No single deadline. Apply for admission before the quarter you want; see the De Anza academic calendar.

name: DECA (high school division)
what_you_do: You can join a school club that prepares you for marketing, finance, hospitality and management careers. It has competitions and conferences.
deadline_text: Join anytime through your advisor.

name: Concurrent Enrollment for High School Students at Diablo Valley College
what_you_do: Take DVC classes on your own while you are still in high school. You earn college credit. The page has a list of high school friendly classes.
deadline_text: You submit the form every term. This page does not list dates.

name: Dual Enrollment (CCAP) at Diablo Valley College
city: Pleasant Hill, CA (also the San Ramon campus)
what_you_do: Take real college classes for free while you are still in high school. Some classes are at DVC campuses, and some are online. You earn college credit.
deadline_text: Each program sets its own dates. For CollegeConnect, the page says current 10th graders are encouraged to apply in February. Ask your counselor about the other programs.

name: DVC Summer Career Academies
city: Pleasant Hill, CA (some at the San Ramon campus)
what_you_do: Try a career field in a short college class made for high school students. You learn by doing and go on field trips. You earn college credit.
deadline_text: The Health and Public Safety academies ran in July 2026. Dates for 2027 are not posted. The page lists these steps: apply to DVC, send the Special Admissions form starting in March, and sign up in the student portal starting in May.

name: Discovery Cube Los Angeles Teen Volunteer
what_you_do: Teen volunteers run hands-on science exhibits, help at birthday parties and support special events at the science center. Most shifts are on weekends, school holidays and in summer.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. Apply online any time.

name: Discovery Cube Orange County Teen Volunteer
what_you_do: You engage guests at exhibits. You lead hands-on activities. You answer visitor questions. You help at events like Bubblefest. You also help with admin tasks and special projects.
deadline_text: Teen application is closed right now. The page says to check back on December 1, 2026 for winter/spring 2027 details.

name: Internship and Career Development Course
what_you_do: You take a school course with weekly coaching on resumes, cover letters and interviews. You get an unpaid internship or prep for paid work. Sites include Davis Public Library, Davis Vanguard, Mercy General and Pemberton Engineering.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. 2026-27 sites are listed now.

name: Dublin L.E.A.D. Summer Program
org: City of Dublin, Parks and Community Services
what_you_do: Teens help City of Dublin camp staff. They help during summer camps and swim lessons. They get training in job skills. They learn to lead activities, water safety and supervising campers.
deadline_text: The 2026 application is closed. The 2026 program ran June 8, 2026 to August 7, 2026. The 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Dublin Youth Advisory Committee (YAC)
org: City of Dublin, Parks and Community Services
what_you_do: Dublin teens give the City input. The input is on its programs and activities for young people. The committee meets monthly. It usually meets on the second Wednesday at the Dublin Senior Center.
grades: Enrolled in middle school or high school
deadline_text: The 2026-27 seats are filled (term June 2026 to May 2027). The city page does not post a recruitment date for the 2027-28 term.

name: EBAYC Volunteers and Student Internships
what_you_do: You can volunteer at a youth group. You can also do a student internship there. The group offers life coaching, school partnerships and community organizing.
deadline_text: Not posted

name: EBMUD High School Summer Internship (HSSI)
city: Oakland, CA and EBMUD service area
what_you_do: You get a paid 6 week summer internship at the water utility. It is about 16 hours a week.
deadline_text: 2026 East Bay program: no direct applications, referrals from partner groups only. 2027 not posted.

name: Junior Lifeguard Cadets (Ages 14 to 17)
city: Hayward, CA (Don Castro Regional Recreation Area)
what_you_do: You join a two week summer lifeguard training session in Hayward at Don Castro Regional Recreation Area. Cadets 15 and older can earn Red Cross lifeguard, CPR and AED certification. Younger cadets can earn a CPR and AED card.
deadline_text: The program page said 2026 cadet applications were due May 6 and accepted cadets had to register by June 12. The next dates are not posted.

name: Leaders-in-Training (LIT) at Park'n It Day Camp
city: Alameda and Contra Costa Counties, CA (regional parks)
what_you_do: For one week you work with other teens to help lead a day camp for kids in a regional park. You learn real job skills.
deadline_text: The program page says applications open in 2027 and gives no date. Interviews are in late April. Accepted teens hear back by mid-May.

name: East Bay Regional Park District Lifeguard Jobs and Lifeguard Academy
city: Alameda and Contra Costa Counties, CA (regional parks and lakes)
what_you_do: You guard swimmers at district pools and beaches. You first take a 10 day paid Lifeguard Academy that teaches the skills.
deadline_text: The program page gives no application dates. The Lifeguard Academy begins in late April. Check the job portal for open posts.

name: East Bay Regional Park District Youth and Student Jobs
city: Oakland, CA and parks across Alameda and Contra Costa counties
what_you_do: You can get seasonal paid student jobs such as recreation leader, lifeguard, gate attendant, student laborer and interpretive student aide. The jobs include pathways from high school to college.
deadline_text: No jobs were posted on governmentjobs.com on Oct 7, 2026. Watch ebparks.org/jobs/youth and governmentjobs.com/careers/ebparks.

name: Youth Environmental Academy and Internships
what_you_do: You join an after-school environmental justice program for Berkeley teens and young adults (8 weeks in summer or 12 weeks in spring). Topics include zero waste, climate resilience and food systems. It is paid.
deadline_text: No dates on the Ecology Center page. Berkeley YouthWorks listed a Winter 2027 interest form due Oct 30, 2026 and said Summer 2027 information comes in Feb 2027, but that page does not mention this academy.

name: Eden Area ROP (Regional Occupational Program)
what_you_do: You take career classes during high school at the Eden Area ROP career center in Hayward or at some home high schools. Class choices include welding, auto, construction, culinary arts, dental assisting, cybersecurity, first responder and education careers.
deadline_text: Enroll through your home school counselor; the page gives no class start dates.

name: Junior Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Spend one 4 to 5 hour shift a week at the hospital through the summer. Juniors do things like escorting patients and delivering items. Older adult volunteers work with you and mentor you.
deadline_text: Last cycle's pattern: names taken in April, interviews in May, orientation in June, program ends end of July. 35 students took part in 2025.

name: El Camino College Dual Enrollment
what_you_do: Take college classes for credit while still in high school.
deadline_text: Fall 2026 (Aug 24 to Dec 12, 2026): registration is still open only for 8-week classes that start in October. The page gives no exact October date, so act soon. For the full term, Winter Session 2027 (Jan 4 to Feb 4, 2027) and Spring Semester 2027 (Feb 16 to Jun 12, 2027) registration starts in November 2026.

name: El Camino Health Junior Auxiliary
city: Mountain View and Los Gatos, CA
what_you_do: You can join a year-long hospital volunteer program for teens in Mountain View and Los Gatos.
deadline_text: No application deadline posted. The page says to check back in mid-January 2027 for signup for the next Junior Application Seminar.

name: El Cerrito Police Explorers
what_you_do: Help the police and your town as a volunteer Explorer. Your Post does many jobs for the police and the town.
deadline_text: No application dates are stated on the program page or on the application form.

name: Youth Member on City Advisory Bodies (non-voting)
what_you_do: Join a city commission or committee as a youth member. You go to meetings and share a teen view. You do not vote.
deadline_text: Applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. Each application on file stays valid for one year from the date received.

name: Elk Grove Youth Commission
what_you_do: Advise the City Council on youth needs. Commissioners meet monthly, meet with their Councilmember, plan youth events and report to the Council.
deadline_text: No open recruitment as of Oct 7, 2026. Seats are filled when openings come up, and the City posts a notice with a Youth Commission application.

name: Environmental Nature Center Leaders in Training
what_you_do: Volunteer with staff at nature camps for kids. You get hands-on practice in nature education and working with kids.
deadline_text: Winter Nature Camp applications are open now. No closing date is posted. Camp dates are December 21 to 23 and December 28 to 31, 2026.

name: Escondido Library Teen Advisory Board
what_you_do: Plan teen programs, keep the teen area welcoming, suggest books for the teen collection, and speak up for teens. The group meets monthly.
deadline_text: The library is accepting new members for the 2026-2027 school year. No deadline is listed.

name: Escondido Public Library Volunteer
what_you_do: Help in library departments with tasks like shelving. Teens can also earn community service hours by writing book reviews on the Review Crew.
deadline_text: The page does not list an application window or deadline.

name: Evergreen Valley College Dual Enrollment and CCAP
what_you_do: You can take free college classes while in high school. You can pick open classes (up to 11 units, 7 in summer), or take a set of college classes taught at a partner high school (up to 15 units a semester).
deadline_text: The page does not state application deadlines or 2026-2027 term dates.

name: EXP Internship Program (paid summer internships for 11th graders)
city: Los Angeles and Long Beach area, CA
what_you_do: You get a summer internship at one of 66 host sites in Southern California. The sites are companies and community groups. The Port of Los Angeles offers a two- to six-week EXP summer internship.
deadline_text: No application dates posted. EXP says to email internship@expfuture.org.

name: High School Internships (Facciotti Lab)
what_you_do: Local high school students work on research in a lab. The work is computational and wet-lab. It happens after school and in summer.
deadline_text: No application process or dates posted.

name: Trailblazers -N- Training
org: City of Folsom Parks and Recreation
what_you_do: You get leadership training (decision-making, conflict resolution, teamwork). Then you volunteer with campers ages 6 to 10 in the Destination Recreation summer camp. You get a T-shirt and a Friday lunch.
deadline_text: 2026 post went up May 22, 2026. 2027 dates not posted yet.

name: Foothill College High School Dual Enrollment
city: Los Altos Hills and Sunnyvale, CA
what_you_do: Take real Foothill College classes for college and high school credit while in high school, on campus, online, or at Sunnyvale Center. Free up to 11 units a quarter.
deadline_text: No single deadline stated. Submit the form before you register each quarter.

name: Orange Coast Medical Center Volunteer
what_you_do: Volunteer in the hospital as part of the patient care team. You work in service areas. After an interview, the Volunteer Office finds you an opening.
deadline_text: No deadline stated.

name: Teen Advisory Group (Teen Tuesdays), Fremont Main Library
org: Alameda County Library, Fremont Main Library
what_you_do: You work with the teen librarians on library projects like book displays and decorating the teen area. You can earn more volunteer hours by leading events.
deadline_text: Three Tuesday shifts are listed for Oct 13 to Oct 27, 2026. The page says the group resumes August 18.

name: Mission Valley ROP high school career classes
what_you_do: You take hands-on career classes in 11 industry sectors and 59 career pathways. Some courses are linked to local colleges, so they may count for college credit.
deadline_text: Students sign up during pre-registration at their home school. The pages checked did not list 2026-27 dates.

name: Fremont Police Explorers (Post 119)
what_you_do: Learn about police work as a volunteer Explorer. You help at community events and with traffic control. You also go on ride-alongs, building tours and school visits. You go to a meeting every week.
deadline_text: The program page says applications are closed right now. It gives no date for the next round.

name: Fremont Recreation part-time jobs (Sports Instructor at 15+)
what_you_do: Work part time for the city's rec programs. Teens 15 and up can be a Sports Instructor or a Tennis Sports Instructor. The Aqua Adventure Waterpark also hires for guest services and water safety.
deadline_text: The program page lists current openings and says to apply online. No closing date is given.

name: Tri-City Volunteers Food Bank and Mobile Pantry volunteering
what_you_do: You volunteer at the Tri-City Volunteers food bank and mobile pantry. You sign up on the volunteer portal.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. Sign up for shifts on the portal.

name: Fremont Unified Career and Technical Education
what_you_do: You can take career and technical education classes at Fremont Unified middle and high schools in 15 industry sectors and 58 career pathways. Some are inside California Partnership Academies or regional occupational programs.
deadline_text: No dates stated. Choose courses at your school.

name: Fremont Youth Advisory Commission
what_you_do: You raise issues that matter to teens and pass them to the City Council. You also help plan forums and workshops for other teens.
deadline_text: The page does not say when applications open.

name: VolunTeens
what_you_do: Teach zoo guests about conservation. Teens volunteer all year on school holidays, breaks and some Saturdays (not in summer). A 1-day training is required.
deadline_text: No deadline posted.

name: Zoo Camp Junior Counselor
what_you_do: Help campers ages 3 to 11 with activities, art projects and games during summer zoo camps.
deadline_text: Applications opened April 1, 2026. Next dates not posted.

name: Parks and Recreation Teen Volunteers
org: City of Fullerton Parks and Recreation
what_you_do: Help run city youth programs and special events in Fullerton. You work with kids, build your resume and can earn school service hours.
deadline_text: The city recruits volunteers each season (fall, winter and spring, and summer). No dates are posted.

name: Fullerton Library Teen Volunteer and Teen Advisory Board
what_you_do: Join the Teen Advisory Board to plan library programs and events. Or write book reviews for the library website. Each Board meeting you attend earns 1 hour of volunteer service. So does each approved review.
deadline_text: No deadline stated.

name: St. Jude Medical Center High School Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Do clerical, non-clinical hospital tasks. The page gives examples for its medical units, such as answering phones and checking on patient needs, but does not list tasks for high school students. You work one 3-hour shift a week.
deadline_text: The page says high school applications may open in early 2027. Spaces are limited and applications are only taken when there are openings.

name: Camp Grove Counselor-in-Training (Garden Grove)
org: City of Garden Grove Community Services Department
what_you_do: Help run Camp Grove, the city summer day camp for kids ages 5 to 12. You get hands-on experience and build leadership skills.
deadline_text: The 2026 application was due Monday, May 4, 2026. The 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Garden Grove Recreation Leader Jobs (Atlantis Play Center and Sports)
org: City of Garden Grove Community Services Department
what_you_do: Work part time at the Atlantis Play Center or the Sports and Recreation Center. You may help run the snack bar and splash pad. You may help with events. You may also referee and keep score at youth games.
deadline_text: The page lists 2026 age cutoff dates. It gives no closing date. Use the Apply link to see which jobs are open now.

name: Garden Grove Teen Action Collaborative (GGTAC)
org: City of Garden Grove Community Services Department
what_you_do: Join a teen leadership group. You do service projects, volunteer at city events and go to career workshops. You can also apply for scholarships.
deadline_text: Applications are accepted September 1 through November 19, 2026. Meetings are the 3rd Thursday of each month, 4:00 to 5:00 p.m.

name: Genesys Works Bay Area Internship Program
what_you_do: You take eight weeks of business technology and job skills training, then work a paid, year-long internship at a partner company. You also get college and career coaching.
deadline_text: No dates posted. Applicants get an interview, then summer skills training.

name: Teen Gallery Guides @ Getty
org: J. Paul Getty Museum (Getty Center and Getty Villa)
what_you_do: You research artworks. Then you lead tours. You also lead gallery activities for school groups and visitors. This is at the Getty Center or Getty Villa. You build public speaking and teaching skills.
deadline_text: The page says the application window typically opens in early February each year. Exact 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Girls Inc. of Alameda County High School Programs
city: Oakland, CA (and Cal State East Bay, Hayward)
what_you_do: You can join free programs for high school girls. The page describes coding projects, college access and leadership programs. It says some programs offer paid summer internships at Bay Area companies.
deadline_text: Not posted. Contact Girls Inc.

name: Glendale Community College Dual Enrollment and Jump Start
what_you_do: Take college classes while in high school. Dual Enrollment is for Glendale and Burbank school district students on an approved class list. Jump Start covers other students and other classes.
deadline_text: Registration opens Oct 19, 2026 for Winter 2027 (Jump Start only) and Nov 30, 2026 for Spring 2027 (Dual Enrollment and Jump Start).

name: Glendale Youth Alliance STEP (Student Training and Employment Program)
what_you_do: Get work training at Glendale Community College's Professional Development Center. Then do 120 hours of paid work at a worksite. The site is picked to match your skills and interests.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. The page says to apply today through the one Apply Now form and a case worker contacts you in 3 to 5 business days. No application window is given.

name: Glendale Youth Alliance Summer Youth Employment and Youth@Work
what_you_do: Youth ages 14 to 24 get paid work experience. The Brush Clearance track is a 6 week supervised brush removal job for youth 14 to 16. Youth with basic job skills can be placed in community jobs.
deadline_text: No dates or deadlines posted. Use the Apply Now form and expect a call back in 3 to 5 business days.

name: Glendale Youth Alliance TEAM (Training, Employment and Mentoring)
what_you_do: Job readiness and mentoring for low-income youth. You learn to be on time, dress right and follow through on tasks. This helps you get ready for college and work.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. The page says to apply today through the one Apply Now form and a case worker contacts you in 3 to 5 business days. No application window is given.

name: Parks and Recreation Commission Youth Member
what_you_do: Be the teen member of a city group that gives advice on parks, beaches and rec centers. You go to about six public meetings a year and share ideas with city leaders.
deadline_text: Applications are due by Nov 12, 2026.

name: Teen Volunteers at Goleta Valley, Buellton and Solvang Libraries
what_you_do: Earn community service hours at the library. You can help with homework help, kids' craft programs, shelving and cleaning books, and staff projects. In summer many teens help with the Summer Reading Program.
deadline_text: Year-round. No deadline. Openings depend on what each branch needs, so check with your branch.

name: Grizzly Youth Academy (National Guard Youth ChalleNGe)
org: California National Guard / California Military Department
city: San Luis Obispo, CA (residential; serves listed central and southern counties)
what_you_do: A free, live in, structured program for teens who are behind in credits or at risk of dropping out. Cadets work on academics, leadership and life skills, and many can earn a GED.
deadline_text: No class start dates or deadlines on the program pages. Start with the online Interest Form and a required virtual orientation.

name: Habitat for Humanity East Bay / Silicon Valley: Volunteer
org: Habitat for Humanity East Bay/Silicon Valley
what_you_do: You help build or repair affordable homes on construction sites. Younger teens can help with fundraising, flyers or lunch.
deadline_text: Ongoing. No sign-up deadline stated.

name: Habitat for Humanity Greater Sacramento: Individual Volunteers (Construction and ReStore)
org: Habitat for Humanity of Greater Sacramento
what_you_do: You help build and repair homes on a job site. Or you work in the ReStore. There you organize, price and stock items. You go to a one hour orientation first. Training, tools and safety gear are provided.
deadline_text: Rolling. Sign up for shifts after orientation.

name: HandsOn Bay Area Youth Volunteering (HandsOn Tomorrow paused)
what_you_do: You can join monthly volunteer projects for younger volunteers. Find them on the HandsOn Community Calendar. Filter by age to see which are open to you.
grades: High school (for HandsOn Tomorrow and the Youth Council)
deadline_text: Monthly projects: sign up on the Community Calendar. HandsOn Tomorrow will not run in summer 2026 and no later dates are posted.

name: ZooTeen Program at Happy Hollow Park and Zoo
org: Happy Hollow Park and Zoo (City of San Jose)
what_you_do: Teens do animal meet-and-greets, help with animal care routines and work as camp helpers. Good for future zookeepers and vet techs.
deadline_text: Applications are accepted year-round and reviewed seasonally. The page says 2026 orientations are complete and 2027 applicants will be contacted at the end of summer 2027, once that orientation schedule is set.

name: Harvey Mudd College Summer Session (high school students welcome)
what_you_do: Take college courses with college students, in person or online. Subjects are computer science, engineering, math and arts. There are also classes in humanities and social science.
deadline_text: For summer 2026, registration began March 2 and the application with transcript was due May 7. Summer 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Hayward Area Historical Society Volunteers
what_you_do: You help at the history museum and old houses. You can lead tours, greet guests, help kids with crafts or work the front desk.
deadline_text: The program page lists no deadline.

name: H.A.R.D. Volunteer Program (Hayward Area Recreation and Park District)
org: Hayward Area Recreation and Park District (H.A.R.D.)
what_you_do: Volunteer at district events and ongoing service projects such as senior programs, nature programs, special needs programs and theatre ushering. Teens can earn community service hours and work experience.
deadline_text: Opportunities are posted throughout the year. No closing date is stated on the page.

name: Hayward Public Library Teen Volunteer Opportunities
what_you_do: Teens help the Children's Room librarians with tasks like cleaning books and craft prep, in 1-hour shifts. Teens can also attend Teen Library Council meetings.
deadline_text: Applications are accepted during the school year. No closing date is stated on the page.

name: Hayward Youth Commission
what_you_do: Youth commissioners advise three groups. Those are the Hayward City Council, the Hayward Area Recreation and Park District and the Hayward Unified School District. They advise on issues that affect young people. They also work on youth projects.
deadline_text: 2025 cycle: applications due Friday, May 9, 2025. Interviews were on Friday, May 30, 2025. No 2026 cycle was found.

name: Hidden Genius Project Immersion Program
what_you_do: You can join a free 15 month program (800+ hours) for Black male high school students. The page describes mentorship, coding and entrepreneurship training.
deadline_text: Our 2027 application is now open (apply page, checked 2026-10-10). No closing date is posted. The immersion page's last listed deadline was Feb 21, 2025.

name: Hiller Aviation Museum Flight Teen Volunteers
what_you_do: Teens run hands-on STEM stations like Imagination Playground and virtual reality for visitors on alternating weekend days.
deadline_text: Applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

name: Hire LA's Youth
org: City of Los Angeles Economic and Workforce Development Department (EWDD)
what_you_do: Get a starter job with work-skills training, career coaching and money lessons. One sub-program puts high school students to work helping elementary kids in LA's BEST after-school programs.
deadline_text: The site banner says it is accepting applications but gives no dates, and its document library page still shows a 2022 summer banner. Call EWDD at 213-744-7300 to confirm the current cycle.

name: Hoag Jr. Auxiliary / Candystripers (High School Volunteer)
what_you_do: You greet visitors in the lobby. You escort people. You work in the gift store. You help in the cancer center infusion area. Duties are limited because volunteers are minors.
deadline_text: The program is full. The page says to check back January 2027 for when interest forms will be taken again.

name: Humane Society Silicon Valley Student Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Students under 18 can foster cats or dogs at home. They need a parent or guardian with them. They can also make no-sew fleece blankets for shelter animals. You earn service hours.
deadline_text: Rolling.

name: Bolsa Chica Conservancy Volunteer Days
what_you_do: Pull invasive plants, plant native ones and pick up trash at the Bolsa Chica wetlands. After a 3 hour training, long-term volunteers can lead wetland activities. They can also restore habitat. Some host visitors at the center.
deadline_text: No deadline. Events happen monthly.

name: Huntington Beach Public Library Teen Volunteering
what_you_do: Pick a library role. Choices include tech helper, LEGO Club assistant and seed library packer. You can also help with a chess or D&D club. You can also do general branch help like crafts, cleaning and setup.
deadline_text: Most roles take online applications with no deadline. The Teen Tech role lists applications Aug 29 to Sep 12 and interviews Sep 15 to 18, printed with no year. The page was last updated Oct 3, 2026, so that window is over for 2026 and no new Teen Tech dates are posted.

name: Huntington Beach Ocean Lifeguard I (Recurrent)
org: City of Huntington Beach Fire Department, Marine Safety Division
what_you_do: Work as a seasonal ocean lifeguard on city beaches. You do ocean rescues and give first aid. You warn people about dangers in the water. You get paid during training.
deadline_text: The 2026 summer posting opened Aug 12, 2025 and closed Apr 13, 2026. The exam was April 4, 2026. The 2027 summer dates are not posted on this page.

name: Huntington Beach Police Explorers
what_you_do: Learn about police and public safety jobs. The program builds leadership and teamwork. You also do community service.
deadline_text: No dates are posted. Start with the interest form on the program page.

grades: High school (can apply the summer before 9th grade)
name: Huntington Beach Youth Collaborative
what_you_do: Sit on a city youth board of 10 to 15 students. Help run the Junior Citizens Academy and Youth in Government Day. Give ideas to city leaders. Volunteer at city events.
deadline_text: The page says applications are now available, with no end date listed.

name: Irvine High School Youth Action Team (HSYAT)
what_you_do: Student reps from local high schools organize teen activities. They speak for their peers at community groups. Check the Instagram account for upcoming events.
deadline_text: The page does not list application dates.

name: Irvine Public Library Teen Volunteers
what_you_do: You help library staff with programs and crafts. You also help with the seed library and toy cleaning. You can help run the Summer Reading Program. Or join the Teen Advisory Group (TAG) for service projects. TAG also gives feedback on teen programs.
deadline_text: The undated page says: Summer Reading applications ran May 9 to May 30, school-year roles will reopen Saturday, August 1, and TAG is full with a wait list for applications after August 26. No year is shown, so confirm current openings.

name: Irvine Police Department Explorer Program
what_you_do: Train with Irvine police. Help with traffic control, community events and DUI checkpoints. After a 5-day academy, you can ride along on patrol.
deadline_text: Send in the interest card by January 1 for the winter session or by June 1 for the summer session. The page does not state the year.

name: UCI Summer Session for High School Students
what_you_do: Take one real UC Irvine college course in the summer, picked from a pre-approved list of courses numbered 1 to 99. Courses are taught at a college level.
deadline_text: Dates for Summer 2027 are not posted yet. Check the Summer Session calendar in spring.

grades: Grades K to 12 (grades 9 to 12 for most options)
name: Irvine Valley College Dual Enrollment
what_you_do: Take regular IVC college classes while in school. You can take up to 11 units a semester, on campus or online. IVC also has high school partner classes and an Early College Pathway. It also runs an Irvine school district summer college.
deadline_text: No single deadline. Follow the steps for each term on the IVC page.

name: One Irvine Workforce Youth Service Corps Summer High School Program
what_you_do: High school students work as Community Services Leaders. You help with summer camps, art programs, events and park setup. You also get job and leadership training.
deadline_text: The page gives no closing date. It says to check back in February 2027.

name: JA Launchpad (Junior Achievement, Fremont)
what_you_do: You will be able to join a new career center in Fremont, coming in early 2027. It offers a money-management simulation, a student business program and career summits with company mentors.
deadline_text: The page says the center is Coming Early 2027. No opening date or sign-up is posted.

grades: Grades 9 to 12 (JA Inspire is grades 11 and 12)
name: Junior Achievement high school programs (JA Company Program, JA Job Shadow, JA Inspire)
city: Los Angeles area, Orange County and Inland Empire, CA
what_you_do: In a class or club, students learn money skills, build and run a small business with a pitch contest, or visit employers for job shadow events. JA Inspire is a career fair with mock interviews.
deadline_text: Schools request programs any time. JA Inspire 2027 is Mar 10 to 11, 2027 at JA Finance Park in Los Angeles. Registration was not open yet.

name: Job Corps Sacramento Center
org: U.S. Department of Labor Job Corps
what_you_do: You can get free live-in career training. Choose construction, carpentry, cement masonry or Certified Nurse Assistant. You also get help finishing high school. You can earn a high school equivalency.
deadline_text: Ongoing enrollment. No dates posted on the Sacramento page.

name: John Muir Health High School Student Volunteer Program (Walnut Creek Medical Center)
what_you_do: Help staff, patients and visitors at Walnut Creek Medical Center in a structured high school program. Students build skills in administration, patient interaction, communication, organization and leadership.
deadline_text: No application window is stated on the official page. Contact a partner high school (for example Acalanes, Campolindo, Las Lomas, Miramonte, Monte Vista, San Ramon Valley or Ygnacio Valley) to ask about the next intake.

name: Junior Achievement of Northern California (high school programs)
what_you_do: You can join Junior Achievement programs on entrepreneurship, investing and personal finance, led by volunteers. Job shadow and Finance Park experiences are also listed, and a Silicon Valley Launchpad center is coming in early 2027.
deadline_text: No central deadline; ask JA.

name: KP LAUNCH High School Program
city: Northern California Kaiser Permanente service areas
what_you_do: You get a paid summer job. It is seven weeks and full time. The jobs are in healthcare support or admin roles. You also get weekly workshops, mentoring and networking. There is little patient contact.
grades: Current high school student (priority to juniors and seniors) or Class of 2027 graduate
deadline_text: Opens Nov 16, 2026 at 9am Pacific; closes Jan 8, 2027 at 5pm Pacific.

name: Keck Medicine of USC Summer Youth Volunteer Program
org: Keck Medicine of USC, Office of Volunteer Services
what_you_do: Volunteer for 8 weeks in summer. You work at Keck Hospital of USC or USC Norris Cancer Hospital.
deadline_text: The page lists the application period as Feb 1 to April 30, with recommendation letters due April 30 (year not stated). Orientation is the second week of June.

name: LA County Bloomberg Arts Internship (BAI) for rising high school seniors
org: LA County Department of Arts and Culture, with Bloomberg Philanthropies
what_you_do: Paid summer internship at an arts or culture group. You work 120 hours over 8 weeks. Monday to Wednesday you are at your worksite. On Thursdays and Fridays you join program days with other interns.
deadline_text: Student applications open in March 2027 when internship listings are posted. No student deadline is posted yet.

name: Los Angeles County Fire Department Explorer Program
what_you_do: Explorers learn what firefighting takes. They build leadership and discipline and do community service. They meet twice a month at their post and go on monthly ride-alongs. They also join yearly trainings and drills.
deadline_text: Open enrollment is usually held once a year in May. Exact 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Los Angeles County Junior Lifeguard Program (ages 9 to 17, with Cadets 16 to 17)
org: Los Angeles County Fire Department Lifeguards
what_you_do: A four-week summer ocean safety program at county beaches. Older returning teens can move up to the Life Saving Team (15 to 17) or Cadets (16 to 17).
deadline_text: Summer 2026 swim tests ran March 14 to April 12. The page says new Junior Lifeguard information is posted each January or February, and parents can expect registration in February or March. Summer 2027 dates are not posted.

name: LA County Library Teen Volunteer and Teen Advisory Board
org: County of Los Angeles Public Library
what_you_do: You can help at your local library. Tasks include kids' storytimes and art activities. You can help with computer and printing help. You can clean and sort materials and make displays. Teen Advisory Boards plan programs.
deadline_text: No deadline. Ask your local LA County Library about current openings.

name: LA County Youth@Work
org: LA County Department of Economic Opportunity (DEO)
what_you_do: Do a paid, part-time first job with a local employer while taking a work-readiness class. You sign up through a nearby America's Job Center of California (AJCC).
deadline_text: No deadline is posted. Fill out the youth interest form and an AJCC contacts you within 48 hours. In 2025 the summer jobs started July 1.

name: Youth Entrepreneurship Academy
org: LA County Office of Small Business (Economic Opportunity)
what_you_do: Join a six-week cohort for young people who want to start a business. The page does not list the lessons. It says the academy is for high school and community college youth.
deadline_text: Cohorts are closed. A waitlist and interest form is on the page. No dates are posted.

name: LA Metro Youth Council
org: Los Angeles County Metropolitan Transportation Authority (Metro)
what_you_do: Teens help Metro learn what young people think about its plans, projects and programs. The council aims to listen, learn, engage, empower and build ridership.
deadline_text: Recruitment for the 2027 council has closed. No dates are posted. A sign-up form on the page gets updates on youth opportunities.

name: Los Angeles Zoo Core Volunteer (students 14 and up)
what_you_do: Core volunteers help zoo guests and support the Zoo's guest engagement programs.
deadline_text: Applications are closed now. The Zoo has a waitlist to tell you when they open. No dates are posted.

name: LACMA Teens
org: Los Angeles County Museum of Art (LACMA)
what_you_do: You learn how museum education works. You plan and run an art workshop with other teens. LACMA staff guide you.
deadline_text: 2026-27 cohort: applications ran July 1 to Aug 21, 2026 (5 p.m.) and are closed. The page says LACMA will not accept applications again until next year.

name: Saddleback Medical Center Volunteer
what_you_do: Volunteer in the hospital as part of the patient care team. You work in service areas. The Volunteer Office finds you an opening.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. The page does not say whether applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

name: Lao Family Community Development: Youth on the Move
what_you_do: You get a paid summer work experience of up to 100 hours through the City of Oakland's summer youth jobs program (MSYEP). Pay is at least Oakland's minimum wage.
deadline_text: No dates posted. The Summer 2026 round is over; call for the next cycle.

name: LAPL Teen Volunteer, Teen Council and Teens Leading Change
what_you_do: You volunteer at your branch library. You organize the teen area. You build displays. You help kids with homework. You help with summer reading. Teen Council and Teens Leading Change add a community project.
deadline_text: No deadline. Teens Leading Change projects form in September, but you can join anytime.

name: Jr. Lifeguard Academy (StarGuard Junior Lifeguard)
org: Livermore Area Recreation and Park District
what_you_do: You learn basic water lifesaving and first aid in a four day summer class. You take part in guided challenges and activities at the pool.
deadline_text: The program page lists three June sessions: June 1 to 4, June 15 to 18 and June 29 to July 2. It does not give a year, and next summer is not posted.

name: Summer Youth Volunteer Program
org: Livermore Area Recreation and Park District (LARPD)
what_you_do: Teens help Livermore Area Recreation and Park District staff. They run summer camps, sports, arts and crafts. They run recreation programs. They can join open space projects with park rangers. Volunteers earn community service hours.
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: sign up for orientation by Friday, March 13, 2026. Orientations were March 19, 2026 (5 to 6:30 pm) and March 25, 2026 (4 to 5:30 pm) at the Robert Livermore Community Center. 2027 dates are not posted yet.

name: Las Positas College CCAP Dual Enrollment
what_you_do: You can take free Las Positas College classes in high school. The classes focus on career technical pathways. Partner programs are in Dublin, Livermore, Pleasanton and Tri-Valley. Tuition and fees are waived. Required materials are provided.
deadline_text: No application dates or deadlines are posted. Students sign the CCAP Dual Enrollment form once for all of high school.

name: Berkeley Lab Director's Apprenticeship Program (BLDAP)
what_you_do: You spend six weeks at Berkeley Lab, at least 4 days a week. You work on machine learning and data science projects, take a computer science short course and talk weekly with STEM professionals.
deadline_text: 2026 applications are now closed, per the page (no window dates given). 2027 not posted.

name: Experiences in Research
what_you_do: You get a paid six-week summer research internship with a Berkeley Lab mentor. Areas include data science, experimental research, coding and science communication.
deadline_text: 2026 window was Feb 2 to Mar 22, 2026 (closed for Summer 2026). 2027 not posted.

name: SeA Bilingual STEM Camp
what_you_do: This is a free spring break camp at Berkeley Lab. It is for bilingual students. They are native Spanish speakers and English learners. It shows students careers in science, technology, engineering and math.
deadline_text: 2026 applications are closed; no 2027 dates posted.

name: LBWIN Youth Career Services Center
org: City of Long Beach Economic Development and Opportunity, Workforce Development Bureau
what_you_do: You can get free career help at a youth center. Services include work-readiness workshops and help finding jobs. You can get paid internships or work experience such as Youth@Work.
deadline_text: No deadline is posted. The page says the school-to-career and partner-referral programs (such as Long Beach Public Service Corps, Port of Long Beach internship and Fire Corps internship) open for set application periods. Use the Youth Interest Form to start.

name: League of Volunteers Teen Volunteers (Summer Recreation)
city: Newark, CA (serves Fremont, Newark and Union City)
what_you_do: You help lead activities. You assist staff at the League's summer recreation program for kids. The League says teen volunteers gain leadership experience.
deadline_text: The homepage showed a 2026 summer teen volunteer call. No 2027 dates are posted.

name: LegiSchool Civics Virtual Institute
org: Sacramento State Center for California Studies with the California State Legislature
what_you_do: You can take a four-week online summer program about California policy. It includes talks from state leaders. It also includes professional skills workshops. You earn a stipend at the end.
deadline_text: 2026 applications closed May 31, 2026. 2027 dates not posted yet.

name: Teen Internship (Summer Camp Staff)
org: Lawrence Hall of Science, UC Berkeley
what_you_do: You help run science summer camps by leading games and activities, preparing materials and supporting campers. Training is in May, and the job is full time in summer.
deadline_text: 2026 applications closed January 15, 2026. Expect a similar mid-January deadline for 2027.

name: Lawrence Hall of Science Youth Volunteers
org: Lawrence Hall of Science, UC Berkeley
what_you_do: You staff exhibits such as the planetarium. Others are Ingenuity Challenges, Outdoor Nature Lab and Animal Discovery Zone. The minimum is 21 summer hours. During the school year, it is 2 shifts a month.
deadline_text: Paused. The page says there will be no Summer 2025 cohort and a re-imagined youth volunteer program is planned for 2026, with no dates posted. The last posted window closed Jan 16, 2024.

name: Livermore Youth Council (LYC)
what_you_do: Speak up for Livermore youth to the City Council, the park district and the school district. Plan projects and events.
deadline_text: The application form is on the Youth Council page. No due date is shown.

name: Young Adult Volunteers (Summer Learning Program)
what_you_do: You help the library with its Summer Learning Program. You do many small library tasks.
deadline_text: The program page lists an application deadline of April 13, 2025. That date is before the 2026 program, so the real deadline is unclear. The page does not give a next deadline or the next summer's dates.

name: ZooTeens Teen Volunteer Program
org: The Living Desert Zoo and Gardens
what_you_do: Volunteer at the zoo two shifts a month and go to monthly meetings. Year one covers animals, conservation and guest service. Later years add projects, leadership, and career help.
deadline_text: The page says it is taking applications for Spring 2027. No deadline is posted.

name: Discovery Program (Summer Health Sciences)
what_you_do: This is a two-week summer program on the Loma Linda campus. It is for high school students interested in health sciences careers.
deadline_text: 2026 applications ran Jan 12 to April 12, 2026. 2027 dates not posted; expect a similar January to April window.

name: Long Beach City College Individual Dual Enrollment
what_you_do: Take college classes at Long Beach City College while you are in middle or high school. Students with 12 or more units by senior year can earn a graduation medallion.
deadline_text: No deadlines listed on the page. See the college's Registration Dates and Academic Calendar pages.

name: Long Beach Commission on Youth and Children (youth seats)
org: City of Long Beach Parks, Recreation and Marine
what_you_do: Two youth members join seven adults to advise the Mayor and City Council. They give advice on city services for kids and teens. They also review the city's youth plan.
deadline_text: No application window is posted.

name: Long Beach Junior Lifeguards Cadet Program
what_you_do: Cadets get advanced first aid and rescue training. They shadow Long Beach lifeguards and help instructors. The goal is leadership and a path to lifeguard or other public service jobs.
deadline_text: Tryout is listed for April 26 at 8:30 AM (year not stated; the age rule uses July 1, 2027). Interviews that day 11 AM to 3 PM.

name: Long Beach Parks, Recreation and Marine Volunteer (13 and up)
org: City of Long Beach Parks, Recreation and Marine
what_you_do: Volunteer at local parks, after school sites and senior centers. You can also help at special events, youth sports and summer programs. Other spots are the Teen Center and El Dorado Nature Center.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. The page does not say whether applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

name: Long Beach Recreation Program Leader (temporary)
org: City of Long Beach Parks, Recreation and Marine
what_you_do: Part-time city recreation job: plan and run activities for children, go to staff meetings and training, and keep kids safe. Hours can reach 40 a week from June through August.
deadline_text: No closing date or ongoing-acceptance statement on the page. The page mentions a job fair on Saturday, Jan. 24, 9 a.m. to 3 p.m. at Houghton Park (year not stated).

name: Long Beach Public Library Teen Volunteers
what_you_do: Help the library staff. You put materials in order and support library programs.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. The page does not say whether applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

name: Long Beach Youth Poet Laureate
what_you_do: Selected poets lead youth poetry programs. They get mentoring from local poets. They send work to the library book of poems. They read at a final show. The term runs May 2027 to April 2028.
deadline_text: Applications open Nov 14, 2026 and close Feb 27, 2027 (no late applications). Finalists told by April 2027. Finals May 22, 2027.

name: Teen Docent Program, Los Altos History Museum
what_you_do: Teen docents work with museum staff, lead tours of the exhibits and the J. Gilbert Smith House, greet visitors and help at special events. They also take on leadership roles.
grades: High school student enrolled in the 2026-27 academic year
deadline_text: Applications for 2026-27 are closed (the page says the deadline for this year has passed). The museum says to check back next spring for the 2027-28 year.

name: Craft Youth Culture teen program
what_you_do: A free program for high school students. Teens visit galleries, talk about art, work with contemporary artists, and do hands-on artmaking projects and guest talks.
deadline_text: Current dates and deadline are not on the program pages. The site lists a 2026 to 2027 page and an older 2025 to 2026 link, so confirm which is current.

name: LA County Independent Living Program (ILP) for foster teens 16 and up
org: LA County Department of Children and Family Services
what_you_do: Free help for teens in or out of foster care with job and internship leads, college prep, SAT prep, financial aid help, a transit pass (ages 18 to 21), and plans for housing. A coordinator helps you start.
deadline_text: No deadline. Services are ongoing.

name: My Friend's Place (drop-in and support for youth with no home)
what_you_do: Free help for young people with no stable home. It offers food, clothing, showers, a phone and internet, help with school and jobs, and links to shelter and housing.
deadline_text: No deadline. Drop-in hours and the street address were not on the program pages.

name: Teen Auto Workshop
what_you_do: Teens learn basic car care on a car from the museum. They learn shop safety and tools. They also learn to find simple problems, change a tire and change oil.
deadline_text: No dates are scheduled. The page says next event to be announced.

name: Safe Place for Youth: work and school help
what_you_do: For youth who are homeless or at risk of it. Staff help with job readiness, resumes, mock interviews, college or trade school applications, and a youth internship program. There is a paid internship in the community garden.
deadline_text: No deadline stated.

name: USC Summer Programs: business courses (Introduction to Business, Exploring Entrepreneurship, and more)
what_you_do: Take one four-week college course. USC teachers and pros teach it. You can pick a business course. Choices include Intro to Business and Exploring Entrepreneurship. Others cover data and green business.
deadline_text: Summer 2027 application information is coming in November (the page does not give a 2026 deadline). The 2026 domestic deadline was May 8, 2026.

name: High School Dual Enrollment at Los Medanos College
city: Pittsburg, CA (classes at partner high schools)
what_you_do: Take college classes taught at your high school, or sometimes on the Los Medanos campus. You earn college credit. The classes can help with college and career plans.
deadline_text: The page lists no dates. Ask your high school counselor when sign-up is each term.

name: Los Rios Dual Enrollment and CCAP (American River, Cosumnes River, Folsom Lake, Sacramento City)
what_you_do: You can take free college classes while in high school. You can enroll on your own at a Los Rios college (special admit), or take a college class at your high school through an agreement between your school and the college.
deadline_text: The page lists no deadlines or term dates for 2026 or 2027. Apply and register by each college's term dates.

name: Junior Docent Volunteers
what_you_do: Volunteer at an aviation museum. Jobs on the form include exhibits, the front desk, the gift shop, collections, events, museum upkeep and aircraft restoration. No experience needed.
deadline_text: Ongoing. No deadlines posted.

name: Externship Program
org: Central Contra Costa Sanitary District (Central San)
what_you_do: Learn about careers in water and wastewater in a short program with an in-person tour. You hear how to apply for summer and internship jobs. You can join online or in person.
deadline_text: The 2026 session was in February. The page says the next session will be announced in 2027. Join the mailing list to hear when.

name: Summer Student Program
org: Central Contra Costa Sanitary District (Central San)
what_you_do: Work a summer job at the sewer and wastewater district. You explore careers in the field and get hands-on work experience in an area you pick.
deadline_text: The page says summer student applications are taken in the first two weeks of March. The exact dates for next year are not posted.

name: Mattel Youth Ambassadors (UCLA Mattel Children's Hospital)
what_you_do: Support Mattel Children's Hospital and patient programs. You meet each week in summer and each month in the school year. You make art projects and hear from doctors. You also work toward a fundraising goal.
deadline_text: The 2026 window ran May 1 to June 6, 2026. Recruitment for Cohort 8 (2027 to 2028) is expected to open in May 2027.

name: Teen Art Collective
org: Museum of Contemporary Art San Diego (MCASD)
what_you_do: This is a yearlong teen program. It includes workshops and visits from artists and museum staff. You get studio time and critiques. The program ends with a teen-organized exhibition and public event.
deadline_text: 2026-2027 applications were due Friday Aug 28, 2026. Next year's dates are not posted; expect a late-summer deadline.

name: College Now (MDUSD and Diablo Valley College)
org: Mt. Diablo Unified School District and Diablo Valley College
city: Pleasant Hill, CA (at Diablo Valley College)
what_you_do: Spend your junior and senior years on a college campus. You take three high school classes taught by Mt. Diablo teachers. You take the rest of your classes at DVC and earn high school and college credit.
deadline_text: Applications for 2026-2027 were due Thursday, Feb 12, 2026, with no late applications. The page says the application is held in the spring. The next dates are not posted.

name: Student Board Member, Mt. Diablo Unified School District
what_you_do: Sit with the school board as the voice of students. You go to board meetings, give input on decisions, and lead the Student Advisory Committee. You are seated with the board and can take part in discussions and cast preferential votes.
deadline_text: Applications for 2026-2027 were due May 29, 2026. The district picks a new Student Board Member each year. The next dates are not posted.

name: Youth Empowerment Services (YES), WIOA Youth Program
city: Concord, CA (serves Central Contra Costa County and Bay Point)
what_you_do: You get a case manager who helps you finish school, plan for college or a career, and find work. Help includes tutoring, job training, mentors, and paid and unpaid work experience.
deadline_text: Ongoing. No deadline is stated on the program page.

name: MemorialCare Long Beach Medical Center High School Volunteen Summer Program
what_you_do: Summer volunteer spots in the hospital, based on what the hospital needs. They consider your wishes but do not promise them.
deadline_text: The 2026 program was full and its application closed. A waitlist was offered. Next year's dates are not posted.

name: Teen Advisory Group (TAG), Menlo Park Library
org: City of Menlo Park, Library and Community Services
what_you_do: Members help promote and improve the library's teen programs and materials. They plan events. They help with library projects. Members earn volunteer hours.
deadline_text: Rolling membership. The page is accepting applications for new members and states no deadline.

name: Youth Advisory Committee (YAC), City of Menlo Park
org: City of Menlo Park, Library and Community Services Department
what_you_do: Teens advise the Parks and Recreation Commission and city staff on youth needs, activities and programs, and help plan youth services. Members serve a one-year term.
grades: Entering grades 9-12 for the upcoming academic year
deadline_text: Closed for 2026-27. The page says applications are accepted May through July for the committee year that starts in September. The next window is not announced.

name: Civil Air Patrol Cadets, Merced County Composite Squadron 147
org: Civil Air Patrol, Merced County Composite Squadron 147
what_you_do: Join the local Civil Air Patrol squadron's cadet program. Cadets across the country learn leadership. They also learn aerospace, fitness and character. They do things like flying, contests and summer encampments. There is also a Cyber and STEM Badge Program.
deadline_text: No deadline. You can ask to join any time.

name: College and Career Access Pathways (CCAP) at Merced College
what_you_do: You take Merced College classes offered through your high school and earn college credit. The program is aimed at students who may not already be college bound.
deadline_text: You apply for each semester you plan to attend. No dates were listed on the page.

name: K-12 Concurrent Enrollment (Merced College)
what_you_do: Take real Merced College classes while you are still in high school, tuition free (limitations may apply). Talk to your high school counselor about which courses fit your schedule.
grades: K-12 students (high school students check with a counselor)
deadline_text: No dates are listed on the page. Registration timing is on the College's When is Registration page.

name: EMPOWER Program (Merced County Office of Education)
what_you_do: This program helps young people who are out of school. It offers tutoring toward a GED or a diploma. You may get paid or unpaid work experience. You learn job skills and leadership. You get a mentor. It also helps you get into college or career training.
deadline_text: No dates posted on the page; it has an online interest and application form.

name: High School Regional Occupational Program (ROP)
what_you_do: Take career classes in several industry sectors at your high school as part of the Merced County ROP. The page links to a program brochure and a Career Industry Day page.
deadline_text: No dates are posted on the page.

name: Volunteer at Mercy Medical Center Merced
org: Dignity Health (CommonSpirit), Mercy Medical Center Merced
what_you_do: You help patients and visitors. You might greet and guide visitors, do office tasks, help move patients, keep patients company, or work in gift shops. Duties differ by place.
deadline_text: The page does not say whether applications are open now. Ask Volunteer Services.

name: Dual Enrollment and Merced College Classes (Merced Union High School District)
org: Merced Union High School District and Merced College
what_you_do: You can earn college credit in high school in three ways. Take online CCAP classes made for high schoolers. Take Merced College classes outside the school day. Or take college courses built into select high school classes.
deadline_text: No dates posted on the district page; check with your school's Pathway Counselor.

name: SkillRISE-CH High School Internship
org: UC Merced (PACE) with Merced County Department of Public Health and Central California Alliance for Health
what_you_do: Finish a project management certificate course in spring, then work in teams on 60 hours of employer-led projects in summer.
deadline_text: The 2025-26 round closed Thursday Dec 18, 2025 at 10:59 PM. Next round dates not posted; it may reopen in the fall.

name: Merced Youth Council
org: City of Merced Parks and Community Services
what_you_do: Speak for Merced's young people to the City Council. You find out what youth need, share ideas with city leaders, plan events and go to monthly public meetings at City Hall.
deadline_text: No application dates are posted.

name: Milpitas Youth Advisory Commission
what_you_do: Youth commissioners advise the Milpitas City Council. They advise on matters that affect youth and teens. The commission meets monthly at the Milpitas Teen Center.
deadline_text: The city says commission applications are accepted year-round, and appointments are made as needed. No closing date is stated.

name: Teens at Mingei
what_you_do: Join a cohort of teens. It has 15 Wednesday evening sessions from October to May. You earn a $750 stipend for full participation.
deadline_text: 2026-2027 applications ran March 2 to April 1, 2026, with interviews April 20 to 24 and notices in August. Next cycle not posted; expect a similar spring window.

name: Mission College High School Dual Enrollment
what_you_do: High schoolers take Mission College classes. Enrollment fees are waived and you pay only for books and materials.
deadline_text: No deadlines listed on the page. Follow the term dates.

name: Mission Hospital High School Auxiliary (Providence)
city: Mission Viejo and Laguna Beach, CA
what_you_do: Volunteer for 4 hours a week in a hospital department. You help patients, visitors and staff but do not give direct patient care. You stay in the program until you graduate.
deadline_text: Applications open September 1 and are due by the 3rd Monday of October. Applications received before or after that date are not accepted. The form is for the 2027 group.

name: MOCA Teen Program (paid)
org: The Museum of Contemporary Art, Los Angeles (MOCA)
what_you_do: Teens work with local artists and museum staff, plan and run MOCA Teen Night, and manage the Teens social media account. The group meets at MOCA on Thursday nights and some weekends.
deadline_text: Applications for 2026-27 are closed (over 130 applied). The next window is not posted.

name: Counselor in Training (CIT) and Future Leaders Programs, Moraga Day Camp
org: Town of Moraga Parks and Recreation
what_you_do: Learn to be a camp leader at the Moraga Day Camp. You shadow Recreation Leaders and help with games, crafts and activities. You also learn how camp programs are planned. CITs help guide the younger campers.
deadline_text: The 2026 interviews were April 13 to 17, 2026. The page lists the sessions as June 15 to July 11 and July 14 to August 8, with no year. Dates for 2027 are not posted.

name: Moraga Police Cadets
what_you_do: Explore police work as a community service cadet. You see how the police department works. You learn about local government, and you join some department training.
deadline_text: No application dates are stated on the employment page.

name: Moraga Youth Involvement Committee (MYIC)
what_you_do: Hold forums and surveys to hear from Moraga youth. Plan community service projects. Give advice to the Town Council on youth issues.
deadline_text: The 2026-2027 application period is closed. The page says applications for the 2027-2028 term will be available in July 2027.

name: City of Mountain View Teen Volunteer Summer Program
org: City of Mountain View, The View Teen Center
what_you_do: Teens join summer camps as Junior Leaders, help swim lessons as Junior Lifeguards, or assist at Deer Hollow Farm camps as interns. Training is included and it is free.
deadline_text: Applications for the 2027 Teen Summer Volunteer Program open in late winter or early spring 2027. No closing date posted yet.

name: Mountain View Youth Advisory Committee (YAC)
what_you_do: Middle and high school students advise the City Council on teen issues, support The View Teen Center and plan teen events. Meets twice a month.
deadline_text: Page still shows an 'Apply now for 2026-2027' banner but gives no closing date; applications opened Feb 6, 2026. Recruitment for the next school year opens each February.

name: Norman Mineta Bay Area Summer Academy (MTC)
org: Metropolitan Transportation Commission (with ABAG, BCDC and the Bay Area Air District)
city: Bay Area (virtual sessions, final session in San Francisco)

name: Summer Youth Academies
org: Sacramento State College of Continuing Education
what_you_do: You can take one-week summer academies. Topics include coding, engineering and robotics. There are also health careers and starting a business. Fashion and fire and emergency services are topics too. The list goes on.
deadline_text: The 2027 schedule is posted in January 2027. Online registration opens Monday, March 1, 2027. No closing date stated.

name: Summer @ City Hall
org: City of Sacramento Youth, Parks and Community Enrichment with SCUSD, Twin Rivers and Natomas USD
what_you_do: This is a six-week summer program about local government. You take daily classes with teachers. Classes run Mon to Thu, 9 am to 2 pm. In the afternoons, you do internships at city locations.
deadline_text: Application opens Apr 1, 2027 and closes Apr 12, 2027. Interviews start Apr 19, orientation May 22, program starts June 14, 2027. Dates are tentative.

name: Sacramento Youth Commission
what_you_do: Serve on the youth advisory group that gives the City Council and the Mayor advice on youth policies and programs. About 19 members.
deadline_text: Apply when a seat is open. No dates posted.

name: Zoo Teens
what_you_do: Run games, crafts and animal activities at education stations in the zoo and teach guests about animals and conservation.
deadline_text: Applications opened online Oct 10, 2026 for Zoo Teens 2027 (Jan to April). Closing date not stated.

name: Sacramento Food Bank and Family Services: Volunteer
what_you_do: Inspect, sort and repack food and help hand it out at the food bank's distribution center.
deadline_text: Online calendar with open shifts.

name: Sacramento County fire explorer, academy and high school fire pathways list
what_you_do: This Metro Fire page lists local youth fire programs: City of Sacramento Firefighter Youth Academy, Cosumnes Explorers, and school fire pathways at Del Campo, SAVA, Inderkum and Valley High.
deadline_text: Varies by program. Spring 2027 for the Sacramento academy and Cosumnes Explorers.

name: Sacramento SPCA Youth Service Projects
what_you_do: Youth groups and students can do community service projects from home. These do not involve working with the animals.
deadline_text: Rolling.

name: Sacramento Works for Youth (WIOA)
what_you_do: You can get job search help. You can get career workshops, resume and interview coaching and mentoring. You can get training and paid work experience.
deadline_text: Recruitment is year-round.

name: Sacramento Youth Center job training and volunteering
what_you_do: You can drop in at this youth center. It offers mentoring. It has classes like sewing, English Club and robotics. It also has job training with hands-on work. You can earn community service hours and volunteer.
deadline_text: No application deadline. Classes have their own start dates (for example Robotics Oct 3 and Sewing Oct 16; the page shows no year).

name: Summer Session Courses Open to High School Students at Saint Mary's College
what_you_do: Take a real college class over the summer on campus. The 2026 high school courses were printmaking, media and cultural studies, and kinesiology. You earn college credit.
deadline_text: Summer 2026 registration opened Feb 20, 2026. It closed June 1 for Session 1 and July 6 for Session 2. Summer 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Heithoff-Brody High School Summer Scholars
what_you_do: Work in a Salk research lab for eight weeks, 30 to 40 hours a week, as a paid intern.
deadline_text: Applications open Dec 1, 2026 and close Feb 15, 2027.

name: High School Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Volunteer at least 100 hours over the school year in hospital departments, with one 3-hour shift a week.
deadline_text: Applications closed. The 2026 deadline was July 30, 2026 at 5:00 pm. The page says applications will be accepted beginning June 1, 2027, with notices by July 29, 2027 and interviews August 2 to 13, 2027.

name: Library Teen Leadership Program (LTLP) and Teen Volunteers
city: San Bernardino County, CA (32 branch libraries)
what_you_do: You volunteer at your branch library. You build leadership skills. Teen volunteers must attend one monthly Teen Leadership meeting.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. Candidates are told the result within 4 to 6 weeks. Meetings are listed from Aug 2026 through May 2027.

name: Sheriff's Explorer Program
what_you_do: Youth volunteers help with traffic control and aviation duties. They also do clerical work, ATV training and crowd control. You go to monthly meetings. You finish the Explorer Academy.
deadline_text: No deadline posted.

name: SPARK Summer Youth Employment Program (San Bernardino County)
org: County of San Bernardino Human Resources
what_you_do: Work a paid summer job in a San Bernardino County department while joining workshops, mentoring and career exploration. You earn a certificate of completion.
deadline_text: 2026 applications opened March 16 and closed at the first 800 applications or March 27, whichever came first. 2025 applications opened March 15. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: San Bernardino County WIOA Youth Programs (Youth Forward)
org: San Bernardino County Workforce Development Board
what_you_do: You can get free help with job skills and leadership. You also get help with career exploring, mentoring and work experience. A local youth provider in your part of the county offers it.
deadline_text: No deadline. Openings depend on each provider's capacity, so call the provider that serves your city.

name: Birch Aquarium Volunteer Program
org: Birch Aquarium at Scripps (UC San Diego)
what_you_do: Start as a Tide Pool Interpreter or Greeter. You talk with visitors about ocean animals and their homes. You share the science done at Scripps Institution of Oceanography.
deadline_text: Applications are taken on a rolling basis. Volunteers are trained four times a year. The next onboarding starts with a virtual info session in early 2027.

name: Cabrillo National Monument Volunteers-In-Parks
org: National Park Service, Cabrillo National Monument
what_you_do: Volunteer at a national park. Roles include removing invasive plants and greeting visitors. You can help with Junior Ranger programs and protect tide pools. You can also guide science activities.
deadline_text: Group projects are open year-round. No deadline stated.

name: Employ & Empower City Internships
what_you_do: Work as an intern in a City of San Diego department. Current postings include Stormwater, Engineering and Police jobs.
deadline_text: Each internship posting has its own closing date. On the job site on Oct 9, 2026, six internship postings were listed, closing from Oct 14 to Oct 30, 2026.

name: Future Civic Leaders
org: City of San Diego (Internship and Work Readiness Program)
what_you_do: Learn about local government and build leadership skills. You meet in person once a month and online every week. You do volunteer projects, go on City job shadows and join skill workshops.
deadline_text: No deadline is listed on the application page.

name: Recreation Aide and Pool Guard (City of San Diego Aquatics)
org: City of San Diego Parks and Recreation, Aquatics
what_you_do: You work at city pools. Recreation Aides give customer service to the aquatics community. They train to be lifeguards. Pool Guards need no certification.
deadline_text: Year-round hiring. Pool Guard hiring events are monthly; Recreation Aide interviews are quarterly.

name: San Diego Youth Commission
org: City of San Diego (Office of Child and Youth Success)
what_you_do: Advise the Mayor and City Council about youth issues. Examples are school, jobs, housing and mental health. You learn about city life, public policy and leadership. You also practice networking.
deadline_text: The page invites youth to apply now. No deadline, application window or open-seat count is listed.

name: Teen Service Learner
what_you_do: You help branch staff organize library materials. You take part in library events. You earn community service hours and work experience.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. Ask your branch.

name: Cuyamaca College Dual and Concurrent Enrollment
what_you_do: Take college classes for credit while still in high school. Classes can count for both high school and college. You can take up to 11 units (4 classes) on campus or online.
deadline_text: Start at least one month before the semester or session. No set deadline on the page.

name: Feeding San Diego Volunteer
what_you_do: Help pack and hand out food. In the Distribution Center, volunteers are 6 and up. At food distributions out in the community, volunteers are 14 and up.
deadline_text: No deadline.

name: San Diego Fire-Rescue Cadet Program
org: San Diego Fire-Rescue Department (City of San Diego)
what_you_do: Learn fire and rescue skills in training taught by SDFD staff, such as vehicle extrication, search and rescue, rope rescue, CPR and advanced first aid. Certified cadets can do ride-alongs with fire crews. A one week Cadet Academy runs each summer.
deadline_text: New cadets are accepted quarterly. No dates are posted.

name: San Diego Food Bank Volunteer Shifts
what_you_do: Sort and bag produce, pack food boxes and bags, and help at community food distributions. No training needed. A short orientation starts each shift.
deadline_text: No deadline. All volunteer visits must be scheduled in advance.

name: JA Fellows and Summer Youth Employment Program
org: Junior Achievement of San Diego County
what_you_do: JA Fellows is a daily class for juniors and seniors on money, the local economy and work skills. It has mentors and job shadows. Fellows ages 16 to 18 can join the summer program. The page calls it paid learning that links to careers.
deadline_text: No student application dates posted. The 2026 summer timeline listed student recruitment in April and the program start in June.

name: JA Stock Market Challenge
org: Junior Achievement of San Diego County
what_you_do: Finish the JA Take Stock in Your Future lessons. Then practice investing in a stock market contest and build a long-term plan.
deadline_text: Event date: Mar 18, 2027. More details will be shared later.

name: La Jolla Playhouse Summer Conservatory
what_you_do: Take an acting intensive with Playhouse artists. Rising 8th and 9th graders do a 9 day program. Rising 10th to 12th graders do a 3 week program with advanced training.
deadline_text: 2026 applications closed Apr 6, 2026. Summer 2027 applications are expected to open on or around Feb 1, 2027. 2027 dates are not set.

name: Playhouse Teen Council
what_you_do: Join a group of high schoolers who learn how a pro theater works. You see shows and meet artists. You plan events that bring young people to the Playhouse.
deadline_text: 2026/27 applications ran Aug 3 to Sept 4, 2026. Next year is not posted yet; expect a similar late summer window.

name: Camp Aides (Youth Volunteers)
org: San Diego Natural History Museum (The Nat)
what_you_do: Help professional educators run summer camps at the museum. The camps are for Pre-K through 8th grade.
deadline_text: Page says recruitment for camp aides begins in May. No 2027 dates posted.

name: Palomar College Concurrent Enrollment for High Schoolers
city: San Marcos, Escondido, Fallbrook and Rancho Bernardo, CA
what_you_do: Take real college classes at Palomar on campus or online while you are in high school. Dual enrollment classes can also be taught at some high schools. The classes count toward a college certificate or degree.
deadline_text: No single deadline. Check the Palomar calendar for each term.

name: Palomar UC San Diego Health Junior Volunteer
what_you_do: Volunteer at the Poway or Escondido hospital. The page lists general roles such as lobby ambassador, escort, desk, book cart and rehab, but does not say which are open to juniors. You complete at least 100 service hours.
deadline_text: Applications are taken all year.

name: San Diego Parks and Recreation Volunteer Program
org: City of San Diego Parks and Recreation Department
what_you_do: Help with park clean-ups, tree planting, youth sports and recreation programs. You can also help at community events. There are roles at Tecolote Nature Center, aquatics, golf and AgeWell Services.
deadline_text: No deadline stated.

name: San Diego Police Cadet Program
org: San Diego Police Department (City of San Diego)
what_you_do: A volunteer role with no police powers. Cadets train twice a month and go on ride-alongs. They help with traffic control and security at community events.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. Recruiting meetings are held on the second Tuesday of each month at 5 p.m.

name: Teen Team Program Assistant
org: San Diego Public Library (City of San Diego)
what_you_do: Join a branch Teen Team. Help library staff plan and lead programs, support teen outreach at community events, and work on special projects.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. Apply any time through the City volunteer system.

grades: Grades 8 to 11 (College Apps Academy is for grade 12)
name: Reality Changers College Town
what_you_do: A free after-school and summer program. You get tutoring, mentoring and college workshops and tours. You also go on service trips, try career experiences and practice public speaking. The page says partners offer access to internships and college courses.
deadline_text: Applications are taken all year. All applicants are added to a waitlist, and staff follow up with next steps.

name: Research Experience for High School Students (REHS)
org: San Diego Supercomputer Center, UC San Diego
what_you_do: Work for 8 weeks on a real computing research project with a UC San Diego mentor and grad students. You learn to test ideas with code and finish with a scientific poster.
deadline_text: 2026 applications ran Feb 15 to Mar 15, 2026. The 2027 dates are not posted yet.

name: Sharp Grossmont Hospital Junior Volunteer
what_you_do: Volunteer at Sharp Grossmont Hospital for at least one year, with one shift a week or two shifts a month.
deadline_text: As of Oct 9, 2026 the page says it is no longer accepting applicants from the high school class of 2028. That means current 9th and 10th graders (classes of 2029 and 2030) may still apply. No deadline is posted.

name: Sharp Memorial and Mary Birch High School Volunteers
org: Sharp Memorial Hospital and Sharp Mary Birch Hospital (Sharp HealthCare)
what_you_do: Greet and guide patients and families, help on nursing units with phones and errands, work in a gift shop, or join Arts for Healing programs. Shifts are 3 to 4 hours a week.
