deadline_text: The high school application is closed, and the page does not say when it will reopen. The adult and college applications reopen Oct 19.

name: UC San Diego Health Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Help patients and staff in hospitals and clinics. Tasks include moving patients, running errands, stocking and lab deliveries. You also greet visitors and visit with patients.
deadline_text: No general deadline is listed, and the page does not confirm 2026 intake dates. Summer-only applicants must apply between Mar 1 and Apr 15, and say so on the application.

name: UC San Diego Marine Science Research Scholars
org: UC San Diego Division of Extended Studies (with Scripps Institution of Oceanography mentors)
city: La Jolla, San Diego, CA (live online)
what_you_do: Take live online ocean science courses in three levels. Level 1 teaches marine biology. Level 2 is hands-on research with Scripps graduate students. Level 3 builds science writing and a chance to publish.
deadline_text: Winter 2027 applications are listed as coming soon. The Fall 2026 deadline (Sept 17, 2026) has passed.

name: San Diego Workforce Partnership youth career services
what_you_do: You can sign up for free career centers. They offer training and one-on-one coaching. Some people get paid on-the-job work experience.
deadline_text: No deadline. The online application takes about 10 to 15 minutes, then staff contact you about next steps.

name: San Jose Middle College (San Jose City College)
org: San Jose Unified School District with San Jose City College
what_you_do: Juniors and seniors take 2 to 3 free college classes. Those are 6 to 9 college credits. They also take 4 high school classes. This is on the San Jose City College campus. You earn a high school diploma and transferable college credit.
deadline_text: Not stated on the San Jose City College page. Ask the Middle College office for the application timeline.

name: San Jose Public Library Teen Volunteers (Teens Reach, Teen Book Reviewer)
what_you_do: Join Teens Reach, the library youth council, to help with kids crafts and Summer Learning sign-ups and to speak up as a library advisor. Or earn service hours by writing book reviews as a Teen Book Reviewer.
deadline_text: Rolling. Each branch has its own Teens Reach sign-up. No single deadline.

name: San Jose Works
org: City of San Jose (work2future and Mayor's Gang Prevention Task Force)
what_you_do: You can get paid work experience and job help in San Jose. If you are 14 to 18 and face barriers to work, you can be placed in paid jobs and training. Job services are open to ages 16 to 29.
deadline_text: No deadline posted on the city pages. Apply any time with the online youth application.

name: San Jose Youth Commission and Youth Advisory Council
what_you_do: Teens advise the San Jose Mayor and City Council on youth issues. The Youth Commission is closed. The Youth Advisory Council (YAC) has an apply page, but it says some districts are paused.
deadline_text: Youth Commission: recruitment is closed, no reopening date posted. Youth Advisory Council: the page has an apply button but does not say if it is open, and says some districts are unavailable or paused. No deadline posted.

name: San Leandro Library Teen Volunteers
what_you_do: You help library staff run programs for younger kids, or help with kit assembly, shelving and displays. You work one shift of 2 to 3 hours a week.
deadline_text: Fall 2026 applications are closed. The page says to check back in November 2026. Summer applications open in mid March, per the summer page.

name: San Leandro Youth Advisory Commission
org: City of San Leandro Recreation and Parks
what_you_do: You give the City Council feedback. The feedback is on issues that affect young people. You help run city events like Pumpkin Splash and the Egg Hunt.
deadline_text: The page does not say when applications open.

name: Jobs for Youth (County of San Mateo)
org: County of San Mateo Human Resources
what_you_do: You can take free job-skills workshops. You can use a members-only job and internship board. There are twenty $2,000 scholarships a year for San Mateo County youth. The county summer internship is for ages 18 to 21.
deadline_text: Membership: the page has an online student registration form but gives no dates or ongoing-intake statement. Workshop dates: email jobsforyouth@smcgov.org. Summer internship: 2026 applications are closed; applications for next summer open early 2027. Scholarship deadline not stated.

name: San Mateo County Libraries Teen Volunteers
what_you_do: Teens shelve books, help with kids' crafts and STEM programs, join outreach events or support the makerspace.
deadline_text: Ongoing. Openings vary by branch and there may be a waiting period.

name: San Pablo Summer Internship Program
org: City of San Pablo Youth, School, and Community Partnerships
what_you_do: Work a paid summer internship in a city department. You get hands-on experience in local government and build job skills. In 2025 the city hosted nine interns.
deadline_text: The page says applications open every January and are due in March. The exact dates for next year are not posted.

name: San Pablo Youth Commission (SPYC)
org: City of San Pablo Youth, School, and Community Partnerships
what_you_do: Speak up for youth in San Pablo and learn how local government works. The commission builds youth leaders and works to improve chances for young people in the city.
deadline_text: The page says the city is taking online applications now. It gives no closing date.

name: Leaders in Training (LIT)
org: City of San Ramon Parks and Community Services
what_you_do: Learn leadership and job skills in class. Then volunteer for a week at a time at city summer camps. You work with kids and learn from staff.
deadline_text: The 2026 program is full and closed. The page says to check back in March for next year.

name: Teen Service and Leadership (TSL)
org: City of San Ramon Parks and Community Services
what_you_do: Take 8 classes on teamwork, resumes, interviews and local government. Then do at least 3 volunteer shifts. Your class also helps host an event for people with special needs.
deadline_text: The fall 2026 class runs Thursdays, Oct 1 to Nov 19, 2026. The page gives no sign-up deadline. Call to ask if spots are left.

name: SPARK High School Internship
org: Sanford Burnham Prebys Medical Discovery Institute
what_you_do: Spend six summer weeks as a fully paid intern in a biomedical research lab.
deadline_text: Next application dates not posted on the page. Use the Request Info form or email the program director.

name: City of Santa Ana Student Intern
org: City of Santa Ana Human Resources
what_you_do: Work in a city department. Go to quarterly workshops to build job skills. Build mentor ties with department leaders. The city lists a Student Intern level for people enrolled in high school.
deadline_text: The city recruits interns about once a year or as needed. No dates are listed on the page.

name: City of Santa Ana Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Volunteer in City of Santa Ana departments. Fill out the volunteer handbook forms and apply through the city volunteer page. Some roles involve working with children.
deadline_text: No deadline stated.

name: Santa Ana Youth (SAY) Employment Program
org: Santa Ana WORK Center (City of Santa Ana)
what_you_do: Get a paid work placement with the city, a public agency or a local group. Selected participants work 15 to 20 hours a week.
deadline_text: The main program page says the city takes applications now, with no end date given. A separate interest page says the program is closed to new applications. The pages disagree, so we cannot say if it is open. Call (714) 565-2600 to confirm before applying.

name: Santa Ana Zoo Volunteers (including Zoo Buddies)
org: Santa Ana Zoo (City of Santa Ana)
what_you_do: Volunteer at the zoo, either as a short-term Zoo Greeter or in a long-term role. Younger teens can join as a Zoo Buddies pair with a parent or guardian.
deadline_text: No deadline. Long-term volunteers do an online and an in-person orientation offered every other month.

name: Civil Air Patrol Cadets, Santa Barbara Composite Squadron 131
org: Civil Air Patrol, Santa Barbara Composite Squadron 131
what_you_do: Join weekly squadron meetings. You get hands-on flight time, STEM projects and leadership milestones. Cadets can serve on search and rescue missions as a Ground Team Member or Mission Radio Operator. They can also help at community events.
deadline_text: No deadline. Contact the squadron to schedule a visit.

name: Youth Career Services (WIOA)
org: Santa Barbara County Workforce Development Board, with Goodwill Industries Youth Centers
what_you_do: Get a paid job at a local business that fits what you like. A boss there coaches you. The program also helps with tutoring, college plans, money skills and leading others.
deadline_text: No deadline. Orientations are held every Tuesday from 4 to 5 p.m. on Zoom.

name: Volunteer Program (Santa Barbara Humane Society)
what_you_do: Volunteer with dogs, cats, the clinic or outreach. You go through a virtual meeting, orientation and role training, then start solo shifts.
deadline_text: No deadline. The page says dog volunteer opportunities are full at the Santa Barbara campus, and says its animal volunteer positions are full at this time. If a role is full, the page offers a waitlist form.

name: Teaching Assistant Program (Santa Barbara Museum of Art)
what_you_do: Assist a Teaching Artist in art classes and camps for kids. You prepare materials. You help with hands-on art-making. You act as a role model. It includes an orientation and mentoring.
deadline_text: Winter After-School Class: apply by Dec 29, 2026 (confirmations Jan 5, 2027). Spring Camp: apply by Mar 15, 2027 (confirmations Mar 22, 2027).

name: Counselors in Training (Santa Barbara Museum of Natural History)
org: Santa Barbara Museum of Natural History
what_you_do: You help run Nature Adventures summer camps for young children. The camps are at the Museum and Sea Center. You do crafts, exhibit visits and activities. You earn community service hours. You also learn to teach.
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: applications opened April 1 and were due April 30, 2026. CIT training was June 12, 2026. Next cycle dates are not posted.

grades: Must be in 8th or 9th grade (or that age) to apply
name: Quasars to Sea Stars (Santa Barbara Museum of Natural History)
org: Santa Barbara Museum of Natural History
what_you_do: This is a three-to-four year program for high school teens. It has museum studies classes and learning from scientists. It includes camping, field trips and volunteering. After 60 community service hours, you become a paid Museum employee.
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: applications were due April 3, 2026, with in-person interviews in April and orientation week June 21-27, 2026. The page says applications for 2026 opened Feb 1, 2026. Next cycle dates are not posted.

name: VolunTEENS (Santa Barbara Museum of Natural History)
org: Santa Barbara Museum of Natural History
what_you_do: You help guests at interpretive tables and science games. You work in the Museum's Backyard, Butterfly Pavilion or Observatory. Shifts are on summer weekends. You earn community service hours.
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: applications opened April 1 and were due April 30, 2026. Training was May 16-17, 2026. Next cycle dates are not posted.

name: Junior Counselor Program (Parks and Recreation)
org: City of Santa Barbara Parks and Recreation
what_you_do: You help summer camp counselors with daily activities. You earn volunteer service hours. You build leadership skills.
deadline_text: No dates are posted on the page. Use the Register link or call Parks and Recreation at 805-564-5418.

name: Parks and Recreation Seasonal Jobs (lifeguard, camp staff)
org: City of Santa Barbara Parks and Recreation
what_you_do: These are seasonal and part-time jobs. They help build workplace skills and experience. Titles include Lifeguard, Camp Counselor, Recreation Leader and Seasonal Program Staff.
deadline_text: No application window or 2026 hiring dates are posted on the program page. Current openings are on an external job board linked from the page.

name: Teen Job and Volunteer Fair (Santa Barbara Public Library)
what_you_do: Meet local employers and nonprofits face to face. Look for summer jobs, internships and volunteer roles. A teen interview skills workshop is held the following week.
deadline_text: 2026 fair: Wednesday, April 15, 2026, 4:00 to 6:00 PM at Central Library (workshop April 22). The 2027 date is not posted; the library calls it annual.

grades: Book reviews: grades 7-12. Teen Advisory Board: high school students.
name: Teen Volunteering and Teen Advisory Board (Santa Barbara Public Library)
what_you_do: You earn community service hours at the library. You can join Teen Volunteer Time. You can join the Teen Advisory Board to plan teen programs and shape the collection. You can also write book reviews.
deadline_text: Teen Advisory Board applications are taken at the start of each school term. Teen Volunteer Time and book reviews are ongoing.

name: Teens Teach Tech (Santa Barbara Public Library)
what_you_do: You learn robotics and coding. Then you work in pairs. You plan and lead one robotics program for children. You plan and lead one for teens at the library. There are six programs in all.
deadline_text: Apply by Saturday, October 24, 2026.

name: Dual Enrollment (Santa Barbara City College)
what_you_do: You take real college courses while in high school. Santa Barbara and Carpinteria Unified students can take them at their high school. All high school and home school students can take them on the SBCC campus or online.
deadline_text: Fall 2026 dual enrollment registration began July 1. Deadlines for each term are on the Dual Enrollment calendar on the SBCC page.

name: Sea Center Volunteers (Ty Warner Sea Center)
org: Santa Barbara Museum of Natural History, Ty Warner Sea Center
what_you_do: Help guests at the Stearns Wharf aquarium meet live animals, from sea anemones to small sharks. You do hands-on demos and live animal talks. Teens 14 and up can earn service hours as exhibit interpreters.
deadline_text: The Museum's teen page says the Sea Center accepts volunteer applications year-round.

grades: 10th or 11th grade (outstanding 9th graders considered case by case)
name: Research Mentorship Program (UCSB Summer Sessions)
what_you_do: You do a college-level research project. A mentor helps you. The mentor can be a grad student, a postdoc or a faculty member. You go to a research talk series. You take part in university life for about seven weeks.
deadline_text: Application window Dec 15, 2026 to Mar 8, 2027. Reviews start in January and decisions are rolling.

name: Summer Research Academies (UCSB Summer Sessions)
what_you_do: You pick a research track in STEM, humanities or social sciences. You take a 4-unit university course. You build a research topic with an instructor. At the end, you present your findings at a capstone seminar.
deadline_text: Application window Dec 15, 2026 to Mar 22, 2027. Reviews start in January and decisions are rolling.

name: Volunteering with a Guardian (ages 13 to 17)
what_you_do: Help care for injured and orphaned wildlife at a rescue center, usually one 4-hour shift a week. A parent or guardian volunteers with you.
deadline_text: No dates posted. A mandatory orientation is required.

name: Santa Barbara Youth Council
what_you_do: Speak for teens to City Council and city departments, recommend youth programs and policies, and plan teen events. Meets twice a month.
deadline_text: Fall 2026 City advisory group recruitment: applications due Monday, October 19, 2026 at 5:00 PM. Applications are accepted year-round for future rounds.

name: Santa Barbara Zoo Jobs for Teens (Guest Experience Specialist and seasonal)
what_you_do: These are entry-level seasonal jobs. Examples are Guest Experience Specialist and Zoo Camp positions. The Zoo says most openings are for applicants 14 and older. It welcomes first-time workers for entry-level roles.
deadline_text: No dates posted. The Zoo says the busiest hiring is a month before spring and summer school breaks.

name: Zoo Teen Volunteers (Junior Camp Counselor, Leader in Training, Teen Conservation Club)
what_you_do: You help run Zoo Camp. You can be a Junior Camp Counselor or a Leader in Training. Or join the Teen Conservation Club. It has monthly meetings and conservation projects.
deadline_text: No application dates are posted. The Zoo volunteer page says it is not taking new volunteer recruitment applications at this time (that line sits in the adult sign-up steps), yet the teen sections still show application links. The Leader in Training dates (June 17 to Aug 23) have no year.

name: Santa Clara County Teen CERT Academy
what_you_do: You take a weekend emergency response course. It covers fire safety, search and rescue, stop the bleed and disaster psychology. After it, you can help your community in disasters. You can earn 20+ volunteer hours.
deadline_text: The newest date on the site is old or unclear. It shows an academy on January 8 to 10 with no year printed, and says the most recent academy was in March 2026. Join the waitlist to hear about the next one.

name: Santa Clara Youth Commission
what_you_do: You advise the City Council on issues that affect teens and help plan events like a 5K run. Fifteen teens serve, and the group meets monthly during the school year.
deadline_text: The 2026-27 recruitment is closed. The page does not give 2027-28 dates.

name: Santa Clarita Public Library Teen Advisory Board (TAB)
what_you_do: Teens give input to the library, meet other teens and can earn service hours. Meetings run September through May.
deadline_text: New members are always welcome. No deadline.

name: County Superintendent Student Advisory Council
what_you_do: Share your views on schools with the County Superintendent at meetings through the school year. You can present at County Board of Education meetings and go on school visits.
deadline_text: The page links a sign-up form but lists no dates or deadline.

name: Job Readiness Training and Paid Internships (Partners in Education)
org: Santa Barbara County Education Office, Partners in Education
what_you_do: Take a weekly job readiness class on resumes, money, networking and interviews, with a career coach. Finish it and you can apply for a paid internship.
deadline_text: Training sessions run Fall (Sept to Nov), Spring (Feb to Apr) and Summer (May to June). The page says the internship application is closed right now.

name: SBIFF 10-10-10 Student Filmmaking Program
what_you_do: For about five months you write or direct a short film with a college partner. The 10 films premiere at the historic Arlington Theatre during the festival. You study script writing, casting, cinematography, lighting, sound and editing.
deadline_text: Applications are closed now. The page says the 2027-28 round opens in spring. No deadline posted.

name: County of Santa Clara Intern and Earn
org: County of Santa Clara Employment Connection
what_you_do: You get an eight week paid county internship, plus job-readiness workshops, hiring events and coaching from an Employment Counselor. You work up to 30 hours a week.
deadline_text: Posted 2026 cohorts: Summer deadline May 20, program June 29 to Aug 7. Fall deadline Sept 19, program Oct 19 to Dec 11. The page also says it is accepting applications now; call to ask about the next cohort. 2027 dates not posted.

name: Santa Clara County Library District Teen Volunteers (tutor a K-6 student)
what_you_do: Teens 14 and older can volunteer at the Santa Clara County Library District. One job is tutoring a student after school. The student is in kindergarten through grade 6.
deadline_text: Ongoing. No deadline posted.

name: County of Santa Clara Student Internship Program (Level I, high school)
org: County of Santa Clara Employee Services Agency
what_you_do: High school students can work as paid student interns in county departments. They help professional staff. They work under close supervision. Tasks depend on the department.
grades: High school (regular, vocational or working toward equivalency)
deadline_text: No current posting for Level I. Subscribe to email alerts on the Student Intern, Level I job title or contact county departments. Applications are reviewed as departments ask and expire after 6 months.

name: Santa Clara County Library District Teen Volunteer Tutor
city: Campbell, Cupertino, Gilroy, Los Altos, Milpitas, Morgan Hill and Saratoga, CA
what_you_do: Teens tutor students in kindergarten to grade 6. They help with homework after school at a library. You can earn community service hours.
deadline_text: Ongoing. No deadline posted.

name: Sacramento County Office of Education Career Technical Education
what_you_do: Through the Sacramento County Office of Education, you can take career technical education courses in 15 industry sectors. The courses mix technical training with academics. The course catalog is posted online.
deadline_text: Course catalog online; no student deadline posted on the page.

name: Volunteer Program (ages 15 and up)
city: San Diego County, CA (La Jolla, Encinitas, San Diego, Chula Vista)
what_you_do: Volunteer at a Scripps hospital in a regular weekly shift. You help patients and visitors. Open to teens 15 and older.
deadline_text: South region (Scripps Mercy San Diego and Chula Vista): reviewed on an ongoing basis. North region (Scripps Memorial La Jolla and Encinitas, Scripps Green): applications open the first business day of April (May orientation) and of October (November orientation); applications sent outside those periods are not reviewed.

name: Santa Clara Valley Medical Center Volunteers
what_you_do: You staff the hospital information desks or the volunteer office for your first 100 hours. Then you move to an area you like. After 6 months and 100 hours you can ask about shadowing.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. Applications are accepted online year-round, and the office is looking for weekday morning or afternoon shifts.

name: Teen Council
what_you_do: Work with museum staff and other teens to share ideas, shape community programs and plan a hands-on art-making workshop. Meets monthly.
deadline_text: 2026-2027 application closed Oct 1, 2026 and the first meeting is Oct 14, 2026. Next year's dates are not posted; expect a similar fall cycle.

name: 826 Valencia Youth Programs
what_you_do: You can get free after-school writing help, workshops, summer programs, and college and leadership support. SFPL lists leadership and writing roles for grades 8 to 12 that pay a stipend.
grades: Programs for ages 6 to 18; stipended roles for grades 8 to 12
deadline_text: No dates posted. Check the 826 Valencia program calendar.

name: Breakthrough Leadership Program (BLP)
what_you_do: High school students are role models for middle schoolers. This is a summer program. You co-teach an elective like dance or soccer. You help with after-school tutoring. You lead cheers and plan events.
deadline_text: The summer 2026 application is closed. The page says the summer 2027 application launches in early 2027; exact dates not posted.

name: Careers in Science (CiS) Intern Program
what_you_do: You do a paid, year-round internship that lasts 2 to 3 years. You do fieldwork, teach visitors and join research projects after school and on Saturdays.
deadline_text: Applications are closed. The page says to check back in February 2027; closing date not posted.

name: CCSF Dual Enrollment (free college classes)
org: City College of San Francisco and SFUSD
what_you_do: Take free City College classes while in high school and earn both high school and college credit.
deadline_text: Not stated on the page. Ask your counselor before each term.

name: Community Youth Center Youth Job Fair
org: Community Youth Center of San Francisco
what_you_do: You can attend this one-day job fair. You meet employers, learn about openings, get resume help, practice interviews, take headshots and get free professional clothing.
deadline_text: Wednesday, October 14, 2026, 12:00 to 4:00 p.m. at Stonestown Galleria.

name: High School Elections Ambassador Program
what_you_do: Learn how to plan and run pre-registration events that help 16 and 17 year olds sign up to vote. Includes an in-person training and a mentor from the Department of Elections.
deadline_text: Fall 2026 applications are closed (the round ran Sept 14 to 27, 2026). The program runs twice a year, in April and September. Spring 2027 dates are not posted.

name: High School Explainer Program
what_you_do: You do a paid museum job. You help visitors at exhibits, lead demonstrations such as cow's eye dissections, and help run museum operations. You get more than 60 hours of training.
deadline_text: School-year applications are typically posted in July and summer applications in March. Closing dates are not stated.

name: San Francisco Fire Youth Academy
what_you_do: This is a free Saturday program. It teaches basic firefighting, CPR and first aid. It also teaches life skills, such as money skills, leadership and time management.
deadline_text: The academy's site shows no class dates or deadline. The newest deadline found is old: a news article from 2025 reported an Aug 11, 2025 deadline for the fall class. Ask the academy if applications are open.

name: Girls on the Run Bay Area Junior Coach
org: Girls on the Run Bay Area
what_you_do: You coach elementary and middle school girls. The program covers running and life skills. You are a junior coach. You work 1.5 to 3 hours a week for 8 to 10 weeks.
deadline_text: The fall Junior Coach application was due Aug 26 (season started early September; 5K on Nov 14, 2026). The page lists no spring Junior Coach dates. A banner about Spring 2027 is for site registration, not Junior Coach applications.

name: Mission Bit Free Coding Classes
what_you_do: You can take free semester-long coding classes. You can take computer science classes too. Classes are in person or remote. There are also workshops, self-paced courses and events.
deadline_text: Fall 2026 class registration is closed. Spring 2027 classes are not posted yet. Workshops and events are posted separately (College Connections is Nov 7, 2026).

name: Mayor's Youth Employment and Education Program (MYEEP)
org: Japanese Community Youth Council (JCYC), funded by SF DCYF; Buchanan YMCA is a partner site
what_you_do: If you are a younger teen, you get job readiness training. You get paid work experience. You also get homework help and mentoring.
deadline_text: School-year round closed Sept 14, 2026. The YMCA page says summer applications are due the first week of April; school-year applications the first week of September.

name: New Door Ventures Employment Program
what_you_do: You can get a six month paid internship with employer partners, plus job coaching, if you are out of school or work.
deadline_text: Applications accepted all year (per the sf.gov youth listing).

name: Opportunities for All (OFA) and Black 2 San Francisco
org: San Francisco Human Rights Commission, with JCYC
what_you_do: You can get a summer internship with local organizations and businesses, plus career workshops and mentorship. Black 2 San Francisco is a separate 6 week program for 30 students.
deadline_text: The 2026 OFA deadline was April 10, 2026. JCYC Workhub says Summer 2027 applications open in February; no exact date.

name: California Pre-Register to Vote (ages 16 and 17)
what_you_do: Sign up early so you are on the voter list the day you turn 18. Pairs well with the SF elections ambassador program.
deadline_text: Always open.

name: Project Pull
org: SF Public Utilities Commission and partner City departments
what_you_do: You can get a paid summer internship in City departments, with a focus on public service and careers such as architecture, business, engineering and science.
deadline_text: The 2027 timeline on the application page says 'details coming soon'. Dates are not posted.

name: YEP! Youth Employment Program
org: San Francisco Recreation and Park Department
what_you_do: You get your first job at rec centers and parks. Areas include arts, sports, aquatics, gardening and cooking. Facility operations is another area.
deadline_text: No dates posted. Email the program to ask when the next round opens.

name: SFPL School-Year Teen Volunteers
what_you_do: Help with children's and family programs at branch libraries. Open spots are at Ingleside, Noe Valley and North Beach. North Beach wants Cantonese or Mandarin speakers.
deadline_text: Rolling. The North Beach opening (Cantonese or Mandarin speakers) starts late October or early November; the page gives no year.

name: SSIP CityWorks (Sewer System Internship Program)
what_you_do: This is a paid summer internship. You work at the San Francisco Public Utilities Commission or at a private engineering firm. The firm works on the sewer system. The program is for students from southeast San Francisco neighborhoods.
deadline_text: No dates posted on the SFPUC page.

name: Teen Volunteer Programs (Nature Trail, Junior Zoologists, Leadership Fellows)
org: San Francisco Zoo and Gardens, Koret Animal Rescue and Conservation Center
what_you_do: You can volunteer at the SF Zoo in three teen programs. Nature Trail is for ages 12 to 14. You show small animals to guests. Junior Zoologists is for ages 15 to 17. You help with animal care. Leadership Fellows is for grades 10 to 12. You help run Zoo Camp.
deadline_text: Nature Trail applications open each March (the page says 2027 applications open in March). Junior Zoologists and Leadership Fellows were closed; 2026 Leadership Fellows group interviews were Apr 25, 2026. No 2027 closing dates posted. A main page banner says teen applications are open; the track pages say closed.

name: UCSF ImmunoExplore Summer Camp
what_you_do: You can attend a free summer camp at UCSF's Parnassus campus. It has lectures, games and Q&A sessions. It has patient panels and live anatomy dissections. UCSF students and faculty mentor you.
deadline_text: The page is out of date (titled Summer Camp 2025, it says 2026 applications are open but posts no dates), so email the program through the Contact Us link before applying.

name: UCSF SEP High School Intern Program
org: UCSF Science and Health Education Partnership
what_you_do: You do a paid eight-week summer research internship at UCSF with a scientist mentor. The program also includes college counseling and a trip to a college campus.
deadline_text: The 2026 application is closed. Last cycle's deadline was Sunday, Feb 8 (the 2026 application). 2027 dates are not posted; fill in the page's interest form to be notified.

name: Youth Art Exchange After-School Programs
what_you_do: You can join free after-school art programs for public high school students. Professional artists lead them, and they build creative, technical and leadership skills.
deadline_text: Contact YAX for current sessions.

name: SF YouthWorks
org: City and County of San Francisco, run with JCYC and DCYF
what_you_do: You can do paid job readiness workshops. You can do internships in City departments, such as the Public Library and SFO Airport. The program also offers mentoring and college tours.
deadline_text: The 2026-27 school-year application is closed (DCYF newsletter: Sept 14, 2026). The Youth Leadership Team application is coming soon. Summer 2027 applications are expected in February (JCYC Workhub page); no exact date.

name: Junior Volunteer Program
org: Sharp Chula Vista Medical Center Auxiliary (Sharp HealthCare)
what_you_do: Volunteer in the hospital for at least one year, with one 2 to 4 hour shift a week.
deadline_text: Application window Oct 1 to Nov 12, 2026 (the application site says Nov 12; the program page says Nov 13, so use Nov 12). Packet due 6 p.m. Nov 12, 2026. Teacher evaluation due 6 p.m. Dec 11, 2026. Results by email Jan 31, 2027.

name: SJSU Summer Session (Open University) for High School Students
city: San Jose, CA (online, hybrid and in person)
what_you_do: High school students can take SJSU summer college courses for credit. They do not have to be admitted first. They take them through Open University. There are more than 500 courses.
deadline_text: Summer 2026: Open University registration began April 15 and closed July 13. 2027 dates not posted.

name: Skirball Teen Advisory Committee
what_you_do: Teens go to trainings and workshops. They support some public programs at the Skirball. They help with research for the remodel of the permanent collection. Members also get into Skirball events for free.
deadline_text: Applications for 2026-27 are closed. The next window is not posted.

name: SLAC Regional High School Science Bowl
org: SLAC National Accelerator Laboratory (U.S. Department of Energy National Science Bowl)
what_you_do: You can compete on a high school team in a science and math quiz at SLAC. Winning teams can move on to the national event, and volunteers are also needed.
deadline_text: Registration opened Oct 5, 2026. High school event is Feb 27, 2027 (middle school is Feb 6, 2027). Registration deadline not posted.

name: SAGE Camp at SLAC
city: Menlo Park and Palo Alto, CA
what_you_do: You can attend a free one-week science camp for high schoolers from all backgrounds. It has hands-on science on the SLAC and Stanford campuses.
deadline_text: 2026 applications ran Feb 24 to Mar 17, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.

name: SMASH Residential (UC Berkeley site)
what_you_do: This is a free STEM program. STEM means science, technology, engineering and math. You live at a university partner for the summer, such as UC Berkeley. It includes computer science, college success, elective classes and STEM career mentors.
deadline_text: Application dates for 2026 to 27 are not posted. Join the interest list for updates.

name: Skyline College Dual Enrollment (San Mateo County CCD)
org: Skyline College, San Mateo County Community College District
what_you_do: You can take tuition-free college classes through your high school and earn high school and college credit at the same time.
deadline_text: No deadline on the page. Ask your counselor about each term.

name: SMUD High School Internship Program
org: SMUD with Sacramento Employment and Training Agency (Sacramento Works)
what_you_do: You do a paid six-week summer internship in areas such as IT, engineering, customer service, vehicle mechanics, accounting, HR and marketing.
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: applications opened Mar 23, 2026 and closed May 1, 2026 (5 pm). 2027 dates not posted yet.

name: South Bay Youth One Stop (work experience and STEP)
what_you_do: Free job training, work experience and internships. You also get skill training and help finding a job. STEP gives work experience for your resume and applications.
deadline_text: No deadlines listed. A Youth Job Fair is linked but no date is on the page.

name: SHINE Student Volunteer Program
what_you_do: You help out at the hospital. The hospital calls this work hospitality tasks.
deadline_text: The page header says volunteering is on hold for now. No dates or deadline are given.

name: Stanford AIMI Summer Research Internship
org: Stanford Center for Artificial Intelligence in Medicine and Imaging (AIMI)
what_you_do: You do mentored, hands-on summer research in health AI. You work with real-world health data on problems where AI and medicine meet.
deadline_text: Summer 2027 program. Application opens Nov 10, 2026 and closes Feb 1, 2027. Free online info session Tue Nov 10, 2026, 5 to 6 pm Pacific, open to students and parents.

name: Stanford CARE Explorers: AI x Precision Health
org: Stanford Center for Asian Health Research and Education
what_you_do: This is a two-week in-person summer program. It covers health topics that affect Asian communities. You learn AI basics and leadership skills. You also learn about precision health data.
deadline_text: 2027 dates will be announced in fall 2026. Sign up for announcements.

name: Stanford Medicine Children's Health Teen Volunteer Program
org: Stanford Medicine Children's Health (Lucile Packard Children's Hospital)
what_you_do: You can volunteer as a teen in one of five areas: mother and baby care, play and recreation, support services, education, and community-based activities.
deadline_text: Openings and requirements are shown during the online orientation. No dates on the page.

name: Genomics Research Internship Program at Stanford (GRIPS)
what_you_do: This is an eight-week summer genetics and genomics research project in a Stanford lab. You work 4 hours a day, 5 days a week. That is about 20 hours a week.
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: opened Dec 2025, due Feb 28, 2026 at 11:59pm (fee waiver request due Feb 15). 2027 dates not posted. The page says summer applications post in December.

name: Stanford Health Care High School Volunteer Program
what_you_do: You can do non-medical volunteer roles in the hospital, one shift a week for at least six months. It is not shadowing and does not count as clinical hours.
grades: Not stated. The page gives a general minimum age of 16.
deadline_text: The page says to use the portal to see the next application dates. Dates not shown on the program page.

name: Stanford Clinical Summer Internship (MEDCSI)
what_you_do: You take a two-week hands-on medical training program, on campus or virtual. This is a fee-based program. You pay to attend, and it is not a job.
deadline_text: All 2026 programs closed. The main page says to check back Jan 1, 2027 for next year's programming; no 2027 application window is posted. Last cycle: Nov 1, 2025 to Feb 9, 2026.

name: Pediatrics Internship Program at Stanford (PIPS)
what_you_do: You do a seven-week summer internship in pediatrics at Stanford, about 30 hours a week. It is for students from nearby counties.
deadline_text: 2026 deadline was Feb 23, 2026 (decisions Apr 1, 2026). 2027 dates not posted.

name: Stanford Institutes of Medicine Summer Research Program (SIMR)
what_you_do: You do eight weeks of full-time biomedical lab research with Stanford faculty and graduate student mentors. Morning lectures are held at the start.
grades: Juniors and seniors (classes of 2027 and 2028 for the 2027 program)
deadline_text: Application opens Dec 18, 2026 at 5pm Pacific; due late February 2027 (exact date not posted). 2026 deadline was Feb 21, 2026.

name: Stanford Medical Youth Science Program (SMYSP)
what_you_do: You can join a five-week, tuition-free summer program on Stanford's campus to explore medicine. It is for current juniors from low-income and first-generation backgrounds.
deadline_text: Closed for 2026 (no 2026 deadline listed). The page says the 2027 application is expected in December 2026. The 2027 session runs June 21 to July 23, 2027.

name: Sunburst Youth Challenge Academy (National Guard)
org: California National Guard and State of California (Sunburst Youth Academy)
what_you_do: This is a free, live in leadership academy for teens who are behind in school. Cadets work on discipline, life skills and school credits. The site says up to 65 high school credits. There is support for 12 months after graduation.
deadline_text: Class 39 begins in January 2027. Applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. The next in person orientation is October 24, 2026 at 1 PM at 4022 Saratoga Ave, Bldg 21, Los Alamitos. You must attend an orientation to start an application, and you must attend Roll Call to be considered for Class 39.

name: City of Sunnyvale Youth Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Youth 13 and older can volunteer. They can help at special events or do office tasks. They can also work with young people or seniors. Library roles are included.
deadline_text: Ongoing. Roles are posted as needed.

name: Silicon Valley Career Technical Education (SVCTE)
org: Silicon Valley Career Technical Education (Metropolitan Education District)
what_you_do: High school job-skills classes in 22 career tracks, including AI engineering, auto repair, culinary arts, nursing, heating and cooling (HVAC), animation and fire science. Some give college credit, and some prepare you for an apprenticeship (paid job training).
deadline_text: Not stated on the program pages. Ask your counselor for enrollment dates.

name: The Tech Interactive Teen Volunteer Program (Holiday Helper)
what_you_do: Teen volunteers lead hands-on science, tech and art activities for museum visitors. This is during the holiday season. Volunteers complete six shifts. Each shift is 3 to 4 hours.
deadline_text: The official page gives no application dates as of Oct 9, 2026.

name: Teen Line Volunteer Listener (peer hotline)
org: Teen Line, a program of Didi Hirsch Mental Health Services
what_you_do: Teens train to give peer support to other teens by hotline, text and email. Adult mental health pros guide the work.
deadline_text: The page says applications are due "Monday September 8, 2026 by 5pm" (that date is a Tuesday, so confirm the day), which has now passed. Training runs three times a year (Fall, Spring, Summer). Next dates are not posted; the page has an email interest list for future applications.

name: Teen Library Council
what_you_do: Help shape what the library offers for teens and earn community service hours.
deadline_text: 2026-27 applications were due no later than August 21, 2026. Next year's date is not posted.

name: TreePeople Volunteer Events (all ages with parent consent)
what_you_do: Sign up for tree planting and other volunteer events. They are listed on the TreePeople events calendar.
deadline_text: Sign up for each event on the Events Calendar. No program deadline.

name: Tri-Valley ROP (Regional Occupational Program)
what_you_do: You can take free career classes through your high school. Your high school is in Dublin, Livermore or Pleasanton. There are 30 or more courses. They cover about 10 career areas. Examples are building trades, health science, IT and public services.
deadline_text: Registration for the 2026-2027 school year is closed. Talk to your school's College and Career Specialist or counselor.

name: Tri-Valley Teen Job and Career Fair
org: City of Dublin, with San Ramon, Pleasanton, Danville and the Dublin/San Ramon Women's Club
city: San Ramon, CA (Alcosta Senior and Community Center)
what_you_do: You go to a free fair to explore job openings around the Tri-Valley.
deadline_text: Saturday, February 27, 2027, 12:00 p.m. to 3:00 p.m. The program page does not describe registration.

name: Trybe Summer Jobs and Paid Internships (East Oakland)
what_you_do: You can get skills building, leadership training and paid internships with Trybe, an East Bay youth program. The City's summer jobs list shows that Trybe offers a 100 hour summer job for East Oakland youth.
deadline_text: The Trybe page shows only a 2022 Youth Summer Internship, marked closed (applications were due May 31, 2022). No 2026 or 2027 dates are posted.

name: Tustin Counselor in Training (C.I.T.) Program
org: City of Tustin Parks and Recreation Department
what_you_do: Help staff at the city summer day camps. You supervise kids, lead games and crafts, and enforce camp rules. You work in the sun and walk and run with the kids.
deadline_text: The 2026 application was due May 1, 2026. Interviews were the week of May 4. Training was Saturday, May 30. The next dates are not posted.

name: Tustin Police Explorer Post 615
what_you_do: Get an inside look at police work. You can ride along with officers, see K-9 work and get firearms training.
deadline_text: No dates are posted. Meetings are held every Wednesday at 6 p.m.

name: Tustin Teens in Action
org: City of Tustin Parks and Recreation Department
what_you_do: Volunteer to help supervise kids and run games and crafts. You also help at city events like Tustin Tiller Days, Halloween Howl and the Holiday Tree Lighting. You build leadership skills.
deadline_text: In the 2026 cycle, applications opened April 1, 2026 and closed May 1, 2026. The interview day was May 23, 2026. The next dates are not posted.

name: Summer VolunTEEN Program
what_you_do: You volunteer in hospital and clinic areas. Examples are patient transport, radiology and discharge. You work 1 to 2 four-hour shifts per week.
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: application completion deadline May 4, 2026 (first come, first served). 2027 dates not posted yet.

name: UC Davis Medical Microbiology and Immunology high school research internship
org: UC Davis School of Medicine with DJUSD and Esparto CTE
what_you_do: This is a 10-week spring program. It meets on Tuesday afternoons. You learn lab safety. You learn to use pipettes, which are tools that measure small amounts of liquid. You watch lab demonstrations and try 3D printing. You visit the Center for Valley Fever.
deadline_text: The newest date found is old. The news article covers a cohort that ran Mar 18 to May 22, 2025, and no 2026-27 cohort is posted. Ask your school's CTE teacher or the internship specialist if it is running.

name: Summer at UC Davis Pre-College Program
org: UC Davis Continuing and Professional Education
what_you_do: You spend two weeks on the UC Davis campus studying a subject you pick, such as pre-med, forensics, equine science or startup entrepreneurship. You live in a UC Davis dorm.
deadline_text: 2025 cycle deadline was May 16, 2025 (the fee page still shows 2025). 2027 dates not posted yet.

name: UC Davis Upward Bound
what_you_do: You get college-prep help during the school year, plus a summer program on the UC Davis campus.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. Check with an Upward Bound advisor at your school.

name: Young Scholars Program (YSP)
what_you_do: You spend six weeks living on campus in a summer program. You work in a UC Davis lab with a faculty mentor on a real project and write a research paper.
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: applications Jan 1 to Mar 1, 2026, teacher references by Mar 3. 2027 dates not posted yet.

name: Summer Session Discount Program for High School Students
what_you_do: Take real UC Merced college classes in summer, online or in person, at a lower price. The credit and grade can transfer to other colleges.
deadline_text: The 2027 dates are not posted. Last year, the application opened Apr 27, 2026 and course enrollment opened May 19, 2026.

name: The Sankofa Experience
org: University of California Office of the President, listed on the UC Riverside summer programs page
what_you_do: A free week living on a UC campus the summer before senior year. You go to workshops on college and applying to UC, meet mentors and build leadership skills. It highlights the Black student experience at UC and is open to all.
deadline_text: The 2027 dates are not posted. Last cycle, the priority deadline was May 15, 2026 and the final deadline was June 1, 2026.

name: COSMOS at UC Irvine (California State Summer School for Mathematics and Science)
what_you_do: You live on campus for four weeks. You take a hands-on, lab-heavy STEM course. It is called a cluster. Faculty, researchers and scientists teach it.
deadline_text: Statewide COSMOS dates: application opens Jan 6, 2027 at 8:00 AM and closes Feb 5, 2027. Financial aid forms postmarked by Feb 6, 2027. Decisions Mar 25, 2027. UCI's own pages still show 2026 dates, so confirm there.

name: UCI Health High School Volunteer Program
what_you_do: You volunteer one weekly three-hour shift at UCI Medical Center. It is for students who think about a medical career. It is also for students who like helping others.
deadline_text: Volunteer applications are currently closed. The page says it is under construction and will be back soon, with no date.

name: UCI ITS PRIME Summer Internship
org: UC Irvine Institute of Transportation Studies
what_you_do: Work in transportation research for 8 weeks in the summer. You need no research experience.
deadline_text: The page says applications are accepted through May each year while space remains. It urges you to apply early.

name: UCI MedAcademy
what_you_do: Spend 5 days learning about medical careers. You work in teams with actors who play patients. You take a medical history, examine them and work out a diagnosis.
deadline_text: Applications open February 1 and close March 1 at 11:59 p.m. Pacific. The page does not state the year. The sessions it lists are in summer 2027. Late applications are not accepted.

name: UCI PERI Institute STEM Education Research Program
what_you_do: Do a STEM education research project with a mentor. Week 1 is on campus. Weeks 2 to 5 are online. Week 6 is a poster show for family and friends.
deadline_text: Applications were rolling and closed on Tuesday, March 31 at 5 p.m. The page does not state the year. The 2027 dates are not posted.

name: UCI Scientific Clinical Research Internship Program (SCRIP)
org: UC Irvine School of Medicine, Office of Research
what_you_do: Volunteer in a UC Irvine research lab under a faculty sponsor. You must line up the sponsor yourself before you apply.
deadline_text: No closing date is posted. The Office of Research collects completed packets every quarter.

name: UCI School of Medicine Summer Online Research Program
what_you_do: Do a healthcare research project with a mentor, online, in a 3-week session. Students in higher grades get priority.
deadline_text: Summer 2026 applications are closed. The page says the program typically closes to new applications by the end of January or the beginning of February. It reviews applications on a rolling basis.

name: UCI Summer Healthcare Experience
what_you_do: Spend one week at the UC Irvine Medical Center. You practice suturing in a surgery simulation lab. You hear from doctors and nurses. You get interview and essay help and finish a health awareness project.
deadline_text: In 2026, applications opened January 26 and closed February 27. No late applications were accepted. The 2027 dates are not posted.

name: UCLA Health Westwood High School Summer Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Help patients and visitors at the hospital. Tasks include moving patients, helping people find their way at entrances and wheelchair help. You can also deliver patient mail and newspapers.
deadline_text: The page says the High School Summer Program is now closed. Information for Summer 2027 will be posted starting January 1, 2027. Hours must be done by August 31.

name: UCLA Summer Sessions for high school students
what_you_do: Take UCLA college courses in the summer, either alongside UCLA undergraduates or in a 3-week focused program (engineering, economics, politics, architecture and more). Earn UCLA credit.
deadline_text: Summer 2026 enrollment is closed. Summer 2027 programs and dates are not posted yet; the site offers a sign-up for 2027 updates.

name: UCR AI-Enabled Robotics Summer Camp
org: UC Riverside, Bourns College of Engineering
what_you_do: A 5-day camp where you learn how robots and the AI behind them work. Labs cover embedded systems, microcontroller programming, and robot cars that avoid obstacles and steer from a phone.
deadline_text: The 2026 deadline was June 6, 2026. Next year's dates are not posted.

name: UCR STEM Summer Camp (wildfire science)
org: UC Riverside, College of Natural and Agricultural Sciences (XCITE Center)
what_you_do: A 5-day hands-on camp on the science of fighting wildfires. You use drone images, 3D video, data science, Python coding, maps and AI tools. Lunch is provided.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. The 2026 camp ran June 22 to 26, 2026.

name: STRIDE Summer Stem Cell Research Training (UCR)
org: UC Riverside, Bourns College of Engineering
what_you_do: Do a 5-week summer research training in a UCR lab on stem cells and regenerative medicine. You also attend skills workshops, speaker sessions, career panels and mentoring.
deadline_text: Recruitment starts in the fall before the program. No deadline is posted. The 2026 session ran June 22 to July 24, 2026.

name: UCR TRIO Pre-College: Upward Bound and Educational Talent Search
what_you_do: This is free college prep support. It includes tutoring, advising, SAT prep and college visits. Upward Bound has a six-week summer program at UCR. It comes with a stipend.
deadline_text: The page posts no deadline and does not say applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. Ask the TRIO office at (951) 827-4865 or trio@ucr.edu about current openings.

name: COSMOS at UC San Diego
org: UC San Diego (Jacobs School of Engineering) / California State Summer School for Mathematics and Science
what_you_do: This is a four-week residential summer program. Motivated math and science students take a hands-on cluster course. They pick the topic. It is on the UCSD campus.
deadline_text: 2027 applications open Jan 6, 2027 at 8 a.m. and close Feb 5, 2027. The statewide site gives 5:00 PM in one place and 11:59 pm in another, so confirm the closing time.

name: Sports Medicine Summer Academy (Research Scholars)
org: UC San Diego Division of Extended Studies
what_you_do: This is a three-week daytime course. It covers sports injuries, anatomy and care. You do hands-on skills like taping and wound care. You do a small research project with wearable tech.
deadline_text: 2026 summer enrollment closed June 26, 2026; fall 2026 enrollment closed Sept 21, 2026. Summer 2027 dates not posted; you can sign up for notifications on the program page.

name: UCSF Health Volunteer Program (includes BCH Oakland campus)
org: UCSF Health / UCSF Benioff Children's Hospitals
city: Oakland, CA (BCH Oakland) and San Francisco
what_you_do: You can do non-medical volunteer work at a hospital. You visit and talk with patients. You do light office work. You help patients and visitors find their way. There is no shadowing, research or internships.
deadline_text: BCH Oakland is not taking new volunteers right now, and the page gives no reopening date. A separate opening on Tuesday, October 13, 2026 at 9:30 a.m. is only for two programs in San Francisco: the Parnassus Patient Amenity Program and the Mt. Zion and Mission Bay Sleep Promotion Program.

name: Union City Youth Commission
what_you_do: You speak for Union City teens to the City Council. You plan community events. You volunteer through the year. You also earn community service hours.
deadline_text: The page lists applications from February 1 to April 1, interviews in April and appointments in May. It gives no year, so treat this as last year's pattern.

name: U.S. Senate Page Program
what_you_do: You get a paid job on the Senate floor. You also work in offices. You attend the Senate Page School for one semester or the summer.
deadline_text: Padilla's office: opens Oct 13, 2026, closes Oct 26, 2026 for the Spring 2027 session.

name: United States Senate Youth Program
org: Hearst Foundations, with the California Department of Education
what_you_do: You spend one week in Washington, DC meeting Senators and officials. The program comes with a $12,500 college scholarship. Two students are chosen per state, and all trip costs are paid.
grades: Juniors and seniors (rising juniors and seniors may apply)
deadline_text: California's deadline for the 2027 program is October 7, 2026. That date has passed. The page does not give a date for the next cycle.

name: USC Summer Programs (pre-college)
org: University of Southern California, Summer Programs
what_you_do: Take one college-level course on USC's campus with college faculty. Choose from 20+ courses in many subjects and earn 3 units of elective credit on a USC transcript.
deadline_text: 2026 deadlines were May 8 for domestic and March 13 for international applicants. 2027 dates and prices are not posted.

name: USC Viterbi Energy of STEM Summer Camp (free)
what_you_do: A free one-week summer camp with demos, hands-on projects and group work. Topics are physics, coding, energy and electronics. SoCalGas employees lead activities with USC staff and students.
deadline_text: The 2026 application closed May 4, 2026 and applicants were told by the end of May. The 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Cyber-AI @ USD
org: University of San Diego, Center for Cyber Security Engineering and Technology
what_you_do: Spend five days at USD learning how to keep computers safe and how AI helps. Teachers and tech workers lead it. You try real tools in labs and games.
deadline_text: No dates are posted.

name: USS Hornet Museum Volunteer (ages 16 and up)
org: USS Hornet Sea, Air and Space Museum
what_you_do: Restore aircraft or the ship, work in the radio room, do outreach, or help visitors. Teens 16 and 17 work with an adult.
deadline_text: The page gives no deadline and does not say applications are rolling or ongoing. Apply through the volunteer form at volgistics.com or call (510) 521-8448 ext. 243.

name: Summer Youth Volunteer Program
what_you_do: This is the Summer Youth Volunteer Program. You volunteer at a VA facility. You can volunteer as an individual or as a group.
deadline_text: The VA page says applications for the 2026 program closed April 24, 2026. The 2024 deadline was April 30. 2027 dates not posted.

name: Valley Humane Society Volunteers
what_you_do: You care for shelter cats and dogs, help in the treatment room, assist staff or help with media. You work one set shift each week.
deadline_text: The program page lists no deadline. You apply for an open shift.

name: Valley Water Youth Commission
org: Valley Water (Santa Clara Valley Water District)
city: San Jose, CA (serves all Santa Clara County)
what_you_do: High school students from across Santa Clara County serve two-year terms on a youth commission for Valley Water. There are 21 seats, each appointed by one of the seven board members.
deadline_text: The application is closed and will open again in Spring 2027. Fill out the interest form to be told.

name: Summer Camp Counselor in Training
what_you_do: Work next to trained instructors at a wildlife summer camp. You guide campers through wildlife games, crafts and other activities.
deadline_text: Summer 2026 applications are closed. The page said applicants would be contacted in April 2026 for interviews. Dates for summer 2027 are not posted.

name: Outstanding Wildlife Leaders (OWL) Teen Program
what_you_do: Spend a year as a teen wildlife leader. You work a 2.5 hour onsite shift each week and give at least 100 hours in the program year. You take part in conservation education that includes public speaking.
grades: Not yet graduated from high school
deadline_text: The 2026-2027 application is closed. The next application dates are not stated on the program page.

name: Save Mount Diablo Volunteer Workdays
city: Walnut Creek, CA (workdays on Mount Diablo land)
what_you_do: Help restore wildlife land near Mount Diablo. You weed, water, plant, clean up and build on workdays. Staff lead the work.
deadline_text: Workdays are posted on an online calendar through the year. Each one has its own date.

name: Washington Health (Fremont) High School Volunteer Program
what_you_do: You can apply to volunteer in hospital roles at Washington Hospital in Fremont. You are a high school student. Openings depend on what the hospital needs.
deadline_text: The high school waiting list closed May 22, 2026. The page says the next high school round is planned for Fall 2026, with the information session date tentative. Students are contacted only when an info session is scheduled. Call 510-818-7465 to confirm.

name: Teen Heroes
org: City of West Sacramento Parks and Recreation
what_you_do: You help staff at city summer camps with set up, clean up, crafts, activities and special events. It is a summer mentoring and volunteer program.
deadline_text: Not stated on the page. Dates for the next summer are not posted.

name: West Valley College Concurrent Enrollment
what_you_do: Students in grades 9 to 12 take West Valley College classes for free. Middle College and on-campus dual enrollment exist for some districts.
deadline_text: No deadline on the page. Follow the college's term dates.

name: Woodland Community College Dual Enrollment (Yolo Community College District)
what_you_do: You can take free college classes as a high school student. Some are at partner high schools. Eleven schools offer them, including Woodland, Pioneer and Winters. Others are online or on campus.
deadline_text: Fall 2026 registration is open now. Spring 2027 applications open in Fall. Deadlines are posted per term; the May 2026 form deadline listed may be out of date.

name: Teens Helping Seniors
what_you_do: Teens earn school community service credit. They serve seniors in Woodland.
deadline_text: No dates on the Teen Programs page.

name: work2future Young Adult Program
what_you_do: You can get career advising and job readiness workshops. You can get paid work experience. You can also connect with employers in Santa Clara County.
deadline_text: Enrollment is open year-round.

name: West Sacramento Home Run Paid Summer Internships
org: West Sacramento Home Run and City of West Sacramento
what_you_do: Apply and interview for a paid summer internship with a local employer. The Home Run team gives work readiness training and the city pays you.
deadline_text: The 2026 Internship Calendar is an image on the page (not readable here). 2027 dates not posted yet.

name: YCOE Work-Based Learning (B-Unbound)
what_you_do: You pick a career interest. Yolo County Office of Education staff match you with a vetted mentor. The mentor works at a business, agency or nonprofit. You complete about 60 hours of hands-on learning.
deadline_text: No deadline or opening date is posted. Ask your school counselor or email CCR@ycoe.org.

name: Youth Employment Partnership (YEP) summer and afterschool jobs
what_you_do: You can get paid job training and work placements in Oakland. Summer programs include Oakland Summer Rising, Team Oakland and Career Try-Out. There are also afterschool jobs.
deadline_text: No closing dates posted. YEP lists an Afterschool Job Application and a Young Adult Program Application 2026.

name: YMCA of Orange County Volunteer Opportunities
city: Fullerton, Huntington Beach, Newport Beach, Laguna Niguel, Mission Viejo (YMCA branches), CA
what_you_do: You can help at YMCA special events at age 14 and up. Events include golf tournaments and 5K races. At 16 and up, you can take an ongoing role. Roles include tutor, sports volunteer and Kids Zone helper.
deadline_text: No dates listed. Special-event volunteering is seasonal, so the page says to stay tuned.

name: YMCA of San Francisco Workforce Development (Teens)
what_you_do: Teens 14 and older build job skills. They get job readiness training. They can earn certifications. They may get paid internships and job placements. What is offered varies by YMCA branch.
deadline_text: Not stated on the page.

name: Outdoor Science School Cabin Leader (Camp Campbell)
what_you_do: Teens mentor students during five-day outdoor science school sessions in the redwoods. They guide activities. They help keep camp safe and fun. Leaders get a full day of training before students arrive.
deadline_text: Applications for the 2026-27 school year open in August and close in the middle of May. The exact closing date is not stated.

name: YMCA Youth and Government (Model Legislature and Court)
what_you_do: You go to weekly local meetings. At in-person conferences in November and February, you act as a lawmaker, lawyer or judge.
deadline_text: Sign-up dates are not stated on the page. A conference is planned for November, so ask now.

name: Yolo County 4-H Youth Development Program
org: UC Agriculture and Natural Resources, Yolo County 4-H
what_you_do: Join a community 4-H club. You do hands-on projects in animals, agriculture, arts and science. You can take part in events and leadership roles.
deadline_text: 2026-2027 enrollment fee posted ($80). No closing date stated; join through a local club.

name: Youth Employment Services (WIOA paid work experience)
what_you_do: You can get paid work experience with a local employer. You can also get help with job searches, resumes and interviews. You can get help with school or training options.
deadline_text: No deadline stated on the page. Contact the Workforce Development Program Manager to check eligibility and enrollment.

name: Youth volunteers at Yolo County Library branches
city: Yolo County, CA (West Sacramento, Winters, Esparto, Clarksburg, Yolo and others)
what_you_do: You help library staff at a Yolo County Library branch. Opportunities differ by branch.
deadline_text: No deadline. Applications are accepted at branches.

name: Youth volunteering at Yolo Food Bank
what_you_do: Help the food bank pack food and work at distributions. Volunteers ages 12 to 17 sign a youth waiver with a parent signature.
deadline_text: Sign up for open shifts any time.

name: Youth Community Service (YCS)
city: Palo Alto, CA (serves Palo Alto, East Palo Alto and nearby)
what_you_do: You can take part in service projects. You can join a peer mental health leadership program. There are school programs and a service award. This nonprofit runs them.
grades: Service Award is for grades K to 12; high school students (grades 9 to 12) need 100 hours within 12 months
deadline_text: Ongoing. Service Award cycles run in four windows; the current one is Fall 2026, Sep 1 to Nov 30, 2026.

name: Youth Radio
what_you_do: You can join a youth media group. You learn journalism, audio storytelling and digital content. Editors are your mentors. You keep control of your own stories.
deadline_text: No dates posted. Youth Radio paused in 2024 and says it is back in 2026.

name: Youth Spirit Artworks job training
what_you_do: You can get arts training and paid jobs if you are a low-income or homeless young person.
deadline_text: Closed as of 2026-10-10. The home page FAQ says YSA is not actively accepting applications. No reopen date is posted.

name: Youth UpRising Summer Jobs and Job Readiness
what_you_do: You can get job readiness training and help finding a job. That includes internships and subsidized work. The Oakland-funded Summer Jobs Program places about 200 youth in jobs each year.
deadline_text: No dates posted on the site. Contact YU in spring for the next summer.

name: YouthBeat Media Careers and Pre-Apprentice Program
what_you_do: You can get free media training in classrooms and afterschool clubs. Advanced students can join a pre-apprentice program and fee-for-service projects at YouthBeat PRO.
deadline_text: No deadline or cohort dates posted, and the site does not say applications are ongoing. Use the Apply link on the site.
